/* ============================================================
   YOSHILOVER — 追加CSS（のもとけ風・ジャイアンツカラー）
   ============================================================ */

/* Google Fonts: Oswald */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Oswald:wght@500;700&display=swap');
/* Google Fonts: Noto Sans JP (v0.23 洗練レイヤー: 本文書体を游ゴシックから昇格) */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+JP:wght@400;500;700&display=swap');

/* CSS変数 */
:root {
  --orange:      #F5811F;
  --orange-light:#FFF3E8;
  --blue:        #003DA5;
  --black:       #1A1A1A;
  --dark-gray:   #333333;
  --mid-gray:    #666666;
  --light-gray:  #E8E8E8;
  --bg:          #F5F5F0;
  --white:       #FFFFFF;
  --red:         #E53935;
  --green:       #2E8B57;
  --purple:      #7B4DAA;
  --gold:        #F9A825;
}

/* ── ボディ背景 ── */
body {
  background: var(--bg) !important;
}

/* ── ヘッダー ── */
.l-header,
.l-header__inner {
  background: var(--black) !important;
  border-bottom: 4px solid var(--orange) !important;
  position: sticky !important;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 100;
}
/* ロゴ・サイト名：白文字 */
.l-header a,
.l-header .c-logo__text,
.l-header .site-name-text,
.l-header .p-logo__title { color: var(--white) !important; }

/* ロゴ文字スタイル */
.l-header .c-logo__text,
.l-header .site-name-text,
.l-header .p-logo__title {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  font-size: 20px !important;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
}
/* キャッチコピー（サブタイトル） */
.l-header .c-logo__desc,
.l-header .p-logo__desc {
  font-size: 10px !important;
  color: var(--orange) !important;
  font-weight: 400 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0;
}
/* ヘッダー内リンク全般をオレンジに */
.l-header .header-x-link,
.l-header .p-headerSearch__icon,
.l-header .c-searchIcon { color: var(--orange) !important; font-weight: 700; }

/* ハンバーガーメニューアイコン */
.l-header .c-hamburger span,
.l-header .p-hamburger span { background: var(--white) !important; }

/* ── グローバルナビ（カテゴリタブ） ── */
.c-gnav,
.l-gnav,
.p-gnav {
  background: var(--white) !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--light-gray) !important;
  overflow-x: auto !important;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}
.c-gnav::-webkit-scrollbar,
.l-gnav::-webkit-scrollbar,
.p-gnav::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

.c-gnav__list,
.l-gnav__list,
.p-gnav__list {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
  white-space: nowrap;
  padding: 0 8px;
  gap: 0;
}

.c-gnav__item > a,
.l-gnav__item > a,
.p-gnav__item > a,
.c-gnav .menu-item > a,
.l-gnav .menu-item > a {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  padding: 10px 14px !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: var(--dark-gray) !important;
  text-decoration: none;
  border-bottom: 3px solid transparent;
  transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
  white-space: nowrap;
  background: transparent !important;
}
.c-gnav__item > a:hover,
.l-gnav__item > a:hover,
.p-gnav__item > a:hover,
.c-gnav .menu-item > a:hover,
.c-gnav .current-menu-item > a,
.c-gnav .current_page_item > a,
.l-gnav .current-menu-item > a {
  color: var(--orange) !important;
  border-bottom-color: var(--orange) !important;
  background: transparent !important;
}

/* カテゴリ色ドット */
.c-gnav .menu-item > a::before,
.l-gnav .menu-item > a::before,
.p-gnav .menu-item > a::before {
  content: '';
  display: inline-block;
  width: 8px; height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.menu-item.cat-all    > a::before { background: var(--orange); }
.menu-item.cat-jiai   > a::before { background: #F5811F; }
.menu-item.cat-senshu > a::before { background: #003DA5; }
.menu-item.cat-syuno  > a::before { background: #555555; }
.menu-item.cat-draft  > a::before { background: #2E8B57; }
.menu-item.cat-ob     > a::before { background: #7B4DAA; }
.menu-item.cat-hoko   > a::before { background: #E53935; }
.menu-item.cat-kyudan > a::before { background: #F9A825; }
.menu-item.cat-column > a::before { background: #1A1A1A; }

/* サブメニュー非表示 */
.c-gnav .sub-menu,
.l-gnav .sub-menu,
.p-gnav .sub-menu { display: none !important; }

/* ── 記事一覧（リスト型） ── */
.-type-list .p-postList,
.p-postList.-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
}
.-type-list .p-postList__item,
.p-postList.-list .p-postList__item {
  background: var(--white);
  border-left: 4px solid transparent;
  transition: background 0.2s, border-left-color 0.2s;
  animation: yoshiloFadeInUp 0.4s ease forwards;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(10px);
}
.-type-list .p-postList__item:hover,
.p-postList.-list .p-postList__item:hover {
  background: var(--orange-light);
  border-left-color: var(--orange);
}
.-type-list .p-postList__item:nth-child(1)  { animation-delay: 0.05s; }
.-type-list .p-postList__item:nth-child(2)  { animation-delay: 0.10s; }
.-type-list .p-postList__item:nth-child(3)  { animation-delay: 0.15s; }
.-type-list .p-postList__item:nth-child(4)  { animation-delay: 0.20s; }
.-type-list .p-postList__item:nth-child(5)  { animation-delay: 0.25s; }
.-type-list .p-postList__item:nth-child(6)  { animation-delay: 0.30s; }
.-type-list .p-postList__item:nth-child(7)  { animation-delay: 0.35s; }
.-type-list .p-postList__item:nth-child(8)  { animation-delay: 0.40s; }
.-type-list .p-postList__item:nth-child(9)  { animation-delay: 0.45s; }
.-type-list .p-postList__item:nth-child(10) { animation-delay: 0.50s; }
@keyframes yoshiloFadeInUp { to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

.-type-list .p-postList__item a,
.p-postList.-list .p-postList__item a {
  display: flex;
  gap: 16px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  padding: 16px 20px;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
}
.-type-list .p-postList__eyecatch,
.p-postList.-list .p-postList__eyecatch {
  width: 120px !important;
  height: 80px !important;
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow: hidden;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.-type-list .p-postList__eyecatch img,
.p-postList.-list .p-postList__eyecatch img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}
.-type-list .p-postList__body,
.p-postList.-list .p-postList__body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

.-type-list .p-postList__cats .c-cat-label,
.p-postList.-list .c-cat-label {
  font-size: 11px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
  padding: 2px 8px !important;
  border-radius: 2px !important;
}
.-type-list .p-postList__date,
.p-postList.-list .p-postList__date,
.-type-list .c-meta__date {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--mid-gray);
}
.-type-list .p-postList__ttl,
.p-postList.-list .p-postList__ttl {
  font-size: 15px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  line-height: 1.5 !important;
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-top: 4px;
  color: var(--dark-gray);
}

/* ── グリッド型（2カラム）記事カード ── */
.-type-card .p-postList,
.p-postList.-card,
.-type-grid .p-postList,
.p-postList.-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 12px;
}
.-type-card .p-postList__item,
.p-postList.-card .p-postList__item {
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
}
.-type-card .p-postList__item:hover,
.p-postList.-card .p-postList__item:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
}

/* ── ページネーション ── */
.wp-pagenavi,
.swell-block-pagenavi,
.p-pagination,
.p-pager,
.c-pagination {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 6px;
  margin: 22px 0 !important;
}
.wp-pagenavi a,
.wp-pagenavi span,
.swell-block-pagenavi a,
.p-pagination a,
.p-pagination span,
.p-pagination .current,
.p-pager a,
.c-pagination a,
.c-pagination span,
[class*="page-numbers"] {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-width: 38px !important;
  min-height: 38px !important;
  padding: 0 10px !important;
  border: 2px solid var(--orange) !important;
  background: var(--white) !important;
  color: var(--orange) !important;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: background 0.18s, color 0.18s, transform 0.18s !important;
}
.wp-pagenavi a:hover,
.p-pagination a:hover,
.p-pager a:hover,
.c-pagination a:hover,
[class*="page-numbers"]:hover:not(.current):not(.dots) {
  background: var(--orange) !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.wp-pagenavi span.current,
.p-pagination .current,
.c-pagination .current,
[class*="page-numbers"].current {
  background: var(--orange) !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
  border-color: var(--orange) !important;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.wp-pagenavi .extend,
.p-pagination .dots,
[class*="page-numbers"].dots {
  border-color: transparent !important;
  color: var(--mid-gray) !important;
  background: transparent !important;
}

/* ── モバイルボトム固定メニュー (p-fixBottomMenu) ── */
.p-fixBottomMenu,
.p-fixBottom,
.c-spBottomMenu {
  background: var(--black) !important;
  border-top: 3px solid var(--orange) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 -2px 12px rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.28) !important;
}
.p-fixBottomMenu a,
.p-fixBottomMenu__link,
.c-spBottomMenu a {
  color: var(--white) !important;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 10px !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.6px;
  transition: color 0.18s, background 0.18s !important;
}
.p-fixBottomMenu a:hover,
.p-fixBottomMenu a.-current,
.p-fixBottomMenu a[aria-current],
.c-spBottomMenu a:hover {
  color: var(--orange) !important;
  background: rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.12) !important;
}

/* ── 画像 + figcaption ── */
.wp-block-image figcaption,
.wp-caption-text,
figure figcaption {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  color: var(--mid-gray) !important;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 6px 4px 2px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.wp-block-image img {
  border-radius: 3px;
}
.wp-block-image.is-style-rounded img {
  border-radius: 999px;
}
/* 画像に hover すると軽く saturate */
.wp-block-image:hover img {
  filter: saturate(1.06);
  transition: filter 0.2s;
}

/* ── SWELL 吹き出し (swell-block-balloon) ── */
.swell-block-balloon {
  margin: 16px 0 !important;
}
.swell-block-balloon__body {
  background: var(--white) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--light-gray) !important;
  border-radius: 10px !important;
  padding: 10px 14px !important;
  position: relative;
  color: var(--black);
  line-height: 1.55;
}
.swell-block-balloon__body::before,
.swell-block-balloon__body::after {
  /* SWELL が生成する quote tail を orange 系に寄せる */
  border-right-color: var(--light-gray) !important;
  border-left-color: var(--light-gray) !important;
}
.swell-block-balloon__name {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 10px !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.8px;
  color: var(--mid-gray) !important;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  text-align: center;
}
.swell-block-balloon__icon {
  border: 2px solid var(--orange) !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  overflow: hidden;
}
/* is-style-think → 点線フキダシ */
.swell-block-balloon.is-style-think .swell-block-balloon__body {
  border-style: dashed !important;
  border-color: var(--orange) !important;
}
/* is-style-speech → orange 背景 */
.swell-block-balloon.is-style-speech .swell-block-balloon__body {
  background: var(--orange-light) !important;
  border-color: var(--orange) !important;
  color: var(--black) !important;
}

/* ── SWELL ブログカード (swell-block-blogCard) ── */
.swell-block-blogCard,
.swell-block-blogCard__inner,
.wp-block-swellBlogCard {
  border: 1px solid var(--light-gray) !important;
  border-left: 4px solid var(--orange) !important;
  border-radius: 4px !important;
  background: var(--white) !important;
  transition: transform 0.18s, box-shadow 0.18s, border-color 0.18s !important;
  margin: 18px 0 !important;
}
.swell-block-blogCard:hover,
.swell-block-blogCard__inner:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.12);
  border-left-color: var(--orange) !important;
}
.swell-block-blogCard__title {
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: var(--black) !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  line-height: 1.45 !important;
}
.swell-block-blogCard__label,
.swell-block-blogCard__externalLink {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 10px !important;
  letter-spacing: 1px !important;
  color: var(--orange) !important;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.swell-block-blogCard__excerpt {
  font-size: 12px !important;
  color: var(--mid-gray) !important;
}

/* ── 目次 sticky (デスクトップ widget 版) ── */
/* SWELL には sidebar 目次 widget がある場合、ここで sticky 化 */
.l-sidebar .widget.ez-toc-widget-container,
.l-sidebar .widget.swell_widget_toc,
.l-sidebar .widget .c-tocBox {
  position: sticky;
  top: 72px;
  max-height: calc(100vh - 90px);
  overflow-y: auto;
}

/* ── デスクトップ sidebar の TOC widget を sticky 化 (長い記事で追従) ── */
@media (min-width: 1024px) {
  .l-sidebar .ez-toc-widget-container,
  .l-sidebar .widget_swell_widget_toc,
  .l-sidebar .widget[class*="toc"],
  .l-sidebar .widget .c-tocBox,
  .l-sidebar .widget-toc {
    position: sticky;
    top: 80px;
    max-height: calc(100vh - 110px);
    overflow-y: auto;
    scrollbar-width: thin;
  }
  .l-sidebar .widget[class*="toc"]::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 5px; }
  .l-sidebar .widget[class*="toc"]::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--orange); border-radius: 999px; }
}

/* ── 読了時間 chip (手書き風 / 将来 plugin 側で .yoshi-read-time.__chip を流し込む用) ── */
.yoshi-read-time,
.c-postTimes__readtime,
.p-postReadTime {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3px;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  color: var(--mid-gray);
  background: rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.04);
  border: 1px solid rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.08);
  padding: 1px 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.yoshi-read-time::before,
.c-postTimes__readtime::before,
.p-postReadTime::before {
  content: '⏱';
  font-size: 11px;
  opacity: 0.75;
}

/* ── モバイル menu パネル polish (SWELL の l-spMenu / p-spNav 等) ── */
.l-spMenu,
.p-spNav,
.c-spMenu {
  background: var(--black) !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
  box-shadow: -2px 0 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
}
.l-spMenu .menu-item a,
.p-spNav .menu-item a,
.c-spMenu .menu-item a {
  color: var(--white) !important;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.6px;
  padding: 12px 16px !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  transition: background 0.18s, color 0.18s, padding-left 0.18s;
}
.l-spMenu .menu-item a:hover,
.l-spMenu .menu-item a:active,
.p-spNav .menu-item a:hover,
.p-spNav .menu-item a:active,
.c-spMenu .menu-item a:hover {
  background: rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.14) !important;
  color: var(--orange) !important;
  padding-left: 22px !important;
}
/* モバイル menu のタイトルラベル (カテゴリ / タグ 等) */
.l-spMenu__label,
.p-spNav__label,
.c-spMenu__label {
  background: rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.12) !important;
  color: var(--orange) !important;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 10px !important;
  letter-spacing: 1.6px !important;
  padding: 6px 14px !important;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.2);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.2);
  margin: 0 !important;
}

/* ── モバイル menu の close ボタン orange ── */
.l-spMenu__close,
.c-hamburger.-open span,
.p-hamburger.-open span {
  background: var(--orange) !important;
}

/* ── モバイル menu の内部 search form orange ── */
.l-spMenu .c-searchForm__s,
.p-spNav .c-searchForm__s {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95) !important;
  border: 2px solid var(--orange) !important;
  color: var(--black) !important;
}
.l-spMenu .c-searchForm__submit,
.p-spNav .c-searchForm__submit {
  background: var(--orange) !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
}

/* ── 共通 notice / alert box (is-style-notice 等) ── */
.is-style-notice,
.is-style-info,
.is-style-alert,
.is-style-warning,
.p-noticeBox {
  border: 1px solid var(--light-gray);
  border-left: 4px solid var(--orange) !important;
  background: var(--orange-light) !important;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  margin: 14px 0;
  color: var(--black);
}
.is-style-alert,
.is-style-warning {
  border-left-color: #E53935 !important;
  background: rgba(229, 57, 53, 0.08) !important;
}
.is-style-info {
  border-left-color: var(--black) !important;
  background: rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.04) !important;
}

/* ── 著者 byline / c-author ── */
.c-author,
.p-authorBox,
.p-articleFoot__author {
  background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid var(--light-gray);
  border-top: 3px solid var(--orange);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  margin: 22px 0 18px;
}
.c-author__name,
.p-authorBox__name {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: var(--black) !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}
.c-author__desc,
.p-authorBox__desc {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--mid-gray);
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* SWELLの「もっと見る」ボタン */
.p-loadMoreBtn,
.c-loadMore__btn {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--white) !important;
  border: 2px solid var(--orange) !important;
  color: var(--orange) !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  padding: 12px !important;
  text-align: center;
  border-radius: 4px;
  cursor: pointer;
  margin-top: 16px;
  transition: all 0.2s;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}
.p-loadMoreBtn:hover,
.c-loadMore__btn:hover {
  background: var(--orange) !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
}

/* ── NEWバッジ ── */
.p-postList__new,
.c-newBadge,
.new-badge,
.p-postCard__new {
  display: inline-block;
  background: var(--red) !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
  font-size: 10px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  padding: 1px 6px !important;
  border-radius: 2px !important;
  margin-right: 6px;
  vertical-align: middle;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* ── カテゴリラベル色（SWELL c-cat-label） ── */
.cat-label-shiai-sokuho,
a[href*="/shiai-sokuho/"] .c-cat-label    { background: #F5811F !important; }
.cat-label-senshu-joho,
a[href*="/senshu-joho/"] .c-cat-label     { background: #003DA5 !important; }
.cat-label-syuno,
a[href*="/syuno/"] .c-cat-label           { background: #555555 !important; }
.cat-label-draft-ikusei,
a[href*="/draft-ikusei/"] .c-cat-label    { background: #2E8B57 !important; }
.cat-label-ob-kaisetsusha,
a[href*="/ob-kaisetsusha/"] .c-cat-label  { background: #7B4DAA !important; }
.cat-label-hoko-iseki,
a[href*="/hoko-iseki/"] .c-cat-label      { background: #E53935 !important; }
.cat-label-kyudan-joho,
a[href*="/kyudan-joho/"] .c-cat-label     { background: #F9A825 !important; }
.cat-label-column,
a[href*="/column/"] .c-cat-label          { background: #1A1A1A !important; }
.cat-label-old-articles,
a[href*="/old-articles/"] .c-cat-label    { background: #999999 !important; }

/* ── カテゴリページのヘッダー色帯 ── */
.p-catHead {
  border-left: 6px solid var(--orange);
  padding: 12px 16px;
  background: var(--white);
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.p-catHead__title { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--dark-gray); }
.p-catHead__desc  { font-size: 13px; color: var(--mid-gray); margin-top: 4px; }

/* ── セクションタイトル（TOPページ見出し）── */
.p-homeSection__head,
.p-widgetTitle,
.wp-block-heading,
h2.swell-block-heading {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
}

/* ── home の widget 見出し (c-secTitle -widget) を hero-lite 化 ── */
/* 対象: w-frontTop 内の widget_recent_entries などの見出し (最近の投稿 等)    */
/* sidebar 側 (.l-sidebar) は既存の黒バー見出しを維持するため scope 限定        */
.w-frontTop .c-secTitle.-widget,
.w-frontTop .c-widget > .c-secTitle {
  position: relative;
  margin: 0 0 10px !important;
  padding: 10px 12px 10px 14px !important;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 16px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  letter-spacing: 1.6px !important;
  color: var(--black) !important;
  background: var(--white) !important;
  border-left: 5px solid var(--orange) !important;
  border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.08) !important;
  border-radius: 2px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.04);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}
.w-frontTop .c-secTitle.-widget > span,
.w-frontTop .c-widget > .c-secTitle > span {
  font-family: inherit;
  color: inherit;
  font-weight: inherit;
  letter-spacing: inherit;
}
.w-frontTop .c-secTitle.-widget::after,
.w-frontTop .c-widget > .c-secTitle::after {
  content: '';
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  margin-left: auto;
  width: 32px;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--orange);
  opacity: 0.6;
}

/* ── home の widget_recent_entries (最近の投稿) を card-list 化 ── */
.w-frontTop .widget_recent_entries > ul {
  list-style: none !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
  background: transparent;
}
.w-frontTop .widget_recent_entries > ul > li {
  list-style: none !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid var(--light-gray);
  border-left: 4px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 2px;
  transition: border-left-color 0.18s, background 0.18s, transform 0.18s, box-shadow 0.18s;
}
.w-frontTop .widget_recent_entries > ul > li:hover {
  background: var(--orange-light);
  border-left-color: var(--orange);
  transform: translateX(1px);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 8px rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.18);
}
.w-frontTop .widget_recent_entries > ul > li > a {
  display: block;
  padding: 11px 14px;
  color: var(--black) !important;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.5;
  text-decoration: none;
  letter-spacing: 0.2px;
}
.w-frontTop .widget_recent_entries > ul > li > a:hover {
  color: var(--orange) !important;
  opacity: 1;
}
.w-frontTop .widget_recent_entries > ul > li .post-date,
.w-frontTop .widget_recent_entries > ul > li .rss-date {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-top: 4px;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: 0.6px;
  color: var(--mid-gray);
}

/* ── リンク色 ── */
a { color: var(--orange); }
a:hover { color: var(--orange); opacity: 0.8; }
.post_content a,
.entry-content a { color: var(--blue); }

/* ── サイドバー ── */
.l-sidebar .widget {
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.l-sidebar .widget-title,
.l-sidebar .widgetTitle,
.l-sidebar .c-widget__title {
  background: var(--black) !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  padding: 10px 16px !important;
  border-left: 4px solid var(--orange) !important;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  margin: 0 !important;
}
.l-sidebar .widget ul { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.l-sidebar .widget ul li { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--light-gray); }
.l-sidebar .widget ul li:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.l-sidebar .widget ul li a {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: var(--dark-gray);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  transition: background 0.2s;
}
.l-sidebar .widget ul li {
  border-left: 3px solid transparent;
  transition: border-left-color 0.18s, background 0.18s;
}
.l-sidebar .widget ul li:hover {
  border-left-color: var(--orange);
}
.l-sidebar .widget ul li a:hover {
  background: var(--orange-light);
  color: var(--black);
}
.l-sidebar .widget_categories .cat-item a { justify-content: space-between; }
.l-sidebar .widget_categories .cat-item a::before {
  content: '';
  display: inline-block;
  width: 7px; height: 7px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--orange);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-right: 4px;
}
.l-sidebar .widget_archive a {
  color: var(--dark-gray);
  font-size: 13px;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
/* 件数 "(12)" 系を Oswald orange tint で数字圧強化 */
.l-sidebar .widget_categories .cat-item a,
.l-sidebar .widget_archive li a {
  position: relative;
}
.l-sidebar .widget_categories .cat-item a > .count,
.l-sidebar .widget_archive li a > .count,
.l-sidebar .widget ul li a .count {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.6px;
  color: var(--orange);
  background: rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.2);
  padding: 1px 7px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
/* SWELL が文字列 "(12)" をリンク末尾に直接書く場合の tint(pseudo)*/
.l-sidebar .widget_categories .cat-item,
.l-sidebar .widget_archive li {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
/* widget 区切りを orange 細ラインに(タイトル前の隙間を締める) */
.l-sidebar .widget + .widget {
  position: relative;
}
.l-sidebar .widget + .widget::before {
  content: '';
  display: block;
  width: 36px;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--orange);
  opacity: 0.45;
  margin: 0 0 14px 0;
}
/* tag cloud の chip 化 */
.l-sidebar .widget_tag_cloud .tagcloud a,
.l-sidebar .tagcloud a {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 11px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: var(--dark-gray) !important;
  background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid var(--light-gray);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 4px 10px !important;
  margin: 2px 3px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  transition: all 0.18s;
}
.l-sidebar .widget_tag_cloud .tagcloud a:hover,
.l-sidebar .tagcloud a:hover {
  background: var(--orange);
  color: var(--white) !important;
  border-color: var(--orange);
}

/* ── Xバナー ── */
.sidebar-x-banner {
  display: block;
  background: var(--black);
  color: var(--white);
  text-align: center;
  padding: 20px 16px;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: background 0.2s;
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.sidebar-x-banner:hover { background: #333; }
.sidebar-x-banner .x-handle {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--orange);
}
.sidebar-x-banner .x-followers { font-size: 11px; color: #999; margin-top: 4px; }
.sidebar-x-banner .x-followers b { color: var(--white); }
.sidebar-x-banner .x-cta {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-top: 10px;
  background: var(--orange);
  color: var(--white);
  padding: 8px 24px;
  border-radius: 24px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  transition: opacity 0.2s;
}
.sidebar-x-banner .x-cta:hover { opacity: 0.85; }

/* ── フッター ── */
.l-footer {
  background: var(--black) !important;
  border-top: 5px solid var(--orange) !important;
  color: #9b9b9b !important;
  margin-top: 44px;
  padding: 28px 0 18px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 -2px 18px rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.18);
}
.l-footer a { color: #9b9b9b !important; font-size: 12px; transition: color 0.2s, transform 0.18s; }
.l-footer a:hover { color: var(--orange) !important; transform: translateY(-1px); }
.l-footer .c-logo__text,
.l-footer .site-name-text,
.l-footer .p-logo__title {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
  font-size: 20px !important;
  letter-spacing: 2.5px;
}
.l-footer__inner { color: #9b9b9b; }
/* footer nav (menu list) */
.l-footer__nav {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 16px !important;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 6px 0 14px !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.18);
  margin-bottom: 14px !important;
}
.l-footer__nav a {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.8px;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  border-right: none !important;
  padding: 0 4px !important;
}
.l-footer__nav li:first-child a { border-left: none !important; }
/* footer bottom copy line */
.l-footer .c-copy,
.l-footer__foot {
  font-size: 11px !important;
  color: #555 !important;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08) !important;
  padding-top: 12px !important;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.6px;
}

/* ── 記事内見出し ── */
.post_content h2,
.entry-content h2 {
  background: var(--black) !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
  padding: 12px 16px !important;
  border-left: 6px solid var(--orange) !important;
  border-bottom: none !important;
  border-radius: 2px;
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.12);
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}
.post_content h3,
.entry-content h3 {
  position: relative;
  border-bottom: 3px solid var(--orange) !important;
  padding: 4px 0 6px 12px !important;
  color: var(--black);
  font-weight: 700;
}
.post_content h3::before,
.entry-content h3::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0; top: 6px;
  width: 4px;
  height: calc(100% - 14px);
  background: var(--orange);
  border-radius: 1px;
}
.post_content h4,
.entry-content h4 {
  border-left: 3px solid var(--orange);
  padding-left: 10px;
  color: var(--black);
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* ── Xポスト埋め込み ── */
.wp-block-embed-twitter,
.yoshilover-x-embed {
  margin: 24px auto !important;
  max-width: 550px;
}
.wp-block-embed-twitter.yoshilover-embed-compact,
.yoshilover-x-embed.yoshilover-x-embed-compact {
  margin: 0 auto 0 !important;
}
.wp-block-embed-twitter .twitter-tweet,
.yoshilover-x-embed .twitter-tweet,
.yoshilover-x-embed .twitter-tweet-rendered {
  margin: 0 auto !important;
}

/* ── 旧記事バナー ── */
.old-articles-notice {
  background: #FFF8E1;
  border: 1px solid #F9A825;
  border-left: 4px solid #F9A825;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #666;
}

/* ── コメント数 ── */
.p-postList__comment,
.c-meta__comment,
.post-comments-count {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3px;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--mid-gray);
  margin-left: 8px;
}
.p-postList__comment::before,
.c-meta__comment::before { content: '💬'; font-size: 10px; }

/* ── メインコンテンツ幅 ── */
.l-main, .l-wrap { max-width: 1200px; }

/* 記事詳細本体の読みやすさ調整 (幅は SWELL layout に従う、行間のみ調整) */
/* 本文 p / li の行間 + 文字サイズ可読域に揃える */
.post_content,
.entry-content {
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.85;
  color: var(--dark-gray);
  letter-spacing: 0.2px;
}
.post_content > p,
.entry-content > p {
  margin: 0 0 1.1em;
}
.post_content > p + p,
.entry-content > p + p {
  margin-top: 0;
}
/* リード文っぽい最初の p は少し大きく */
.post_content > p:first-of-type,
.entry-content > p:first-of-type {
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.85;
  color: var(--black);
}
/* 強調 strong / em を巨人色で */
.post_content strong,
.entry-content strong {
  color: var(--black);
  font-weight: 800;
  background: linear-gradient(transparent 62%, rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.22) 62%);
  padding: 0 2px;
}
.post_content em,
.entry-content em {
  font-style: normal;
  color: var(--orange);
  font-weight: 700;
}
/* 文中 code */
.post_content code,
.entry-content code {
  background: rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.06);
  color: var(--black);
  padding: 1px 6px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  font-size: 0.88em;
  font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
  border: 1px solid rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.08);
}
/* pre block */
.post_content pre,
.entry-content pre,
.wp-block-code {
  background: var(--black) !important;
  color: #eee !important;
  padding: 14px 16px !important;
  border-radius: 3px !important;
  border-left: 4px solid var(--orange) !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
  line-height: 1.6 !important;
  overflow-x: auto !important;
}

/* ── 記事詳細ページ ── */
.p-entryTitle { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.5; }
.c-meta { font-size: 12px; color: var(--mid-gray); }

/* 記事タイトル (SWELL: .c-postTitle / .c-postTitle__ttl) を hero 化 */
.p-articleHead.c-postTitle,
.c-postTitle {
  position: relative;
  padding: 14px 0 12px 14px !important;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  border-left: 5px solid var(--orange);
  background: var(--white);
}
.c-postTitle__ttl {
  font-size: clamp(20px, 4.4vw, 26px) !important;
  line-height: 1.45 !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  color: var(--black) !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.2px;
}
.c-postTitle__date {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.8px;
  color: var(--orange) !important;
  font-weight: 700;
}
/* 記事カテゴリリスト (title 下) */
.p-articleMetas__termList .c-categoryList__link,
.c-categoryList__link {
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px !important;
  border-radius: 2px !important;
  padding: 2px 10px !important;
}
/* 記事投稿時刻 (upper) を Oswald に */
.p-articleMetas .c-postTimes__posted,
.p-articleMetas .c-postTimes__modified {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.6px;
  color: var(--mid-gray);
}
/* 記事サムネイル (eyecatch) に下辺 orange アクセント */
.p-articleThumb,
.p-entryEyeCatch,
.c-postThumb.-eyeCatch {
  position: relative;
  border-bottom: 3px solid var(--orange);
  border-radius: 2px;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}
.p-articleThumb__img,
.p-entryEyeCatch__img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}

/* パン屑 (breadcrumb) を Oswald + orange current + ▸ separator */
.p-breadcrumb {
  font-size: 11px !important;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  color: var(--mid-gray);
  padding: 6px 0 8px !important;
}
.p-breadcrumb a { color: var(--mid-gray) !important; font-weight: 700; }
.p-breadcrumb a:hover { color: var(--orange) !important; opacity: 1; }
.p-breadcrumb__item.-current,
.p-breadcrumb li:last-child,
.p-breadcrumb__current { color: var(--black) !important; font-weight: 700; }
/* separator ▸ を orange に */
.p-breadcrumb__list > li + li::before,
.p-breadcrumb__item + .p-breadcrumb__item::before {
  content: '▸' !important;
  color: var(--orange);
  margin: 0 6px;
  font-weight: 700;
}
/* ホームアイコンを 🏠 に置換 (テーマ依存で効かない場合あり) */
.p-breadcrumb__list > li:first-child a::before,
.p-breadcrumb__item:first-child a::before {
  content: '';
  display: inline-block;
  width: 3px;
  height: 3px;
  background: var(--orange);
  border-radius: 999px;
  margin-right: 6px;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

/* ── アーカイブページの post list item に カテゴリ色 accent ── */
/* body.category-<slug> p-postList__item 全部 左 border 色分岐 */
body.category-shiai-sokuho .-type-list .p-postList__item,
body.category-shiai-sokuho .p-postList.-list .p-postList__item { border-left-color: #F5811F !important; }
body.category-senshu-joho .-type-list .p-postList__item,
body.category-senshu-joho .p-postList.-list .p-postList__item { border-left-color: #003DA5 !important; }
body.category-syuno .-type-list .p-postList__item,
body.category-syuno .p-postList.-list .p-postList__item { border-left-color: #555 !important; }
body.category-draft-ikusei .-type-list .p-postList__item,
body.category-draft-ikusei .p-postList.-list .p-postList__item { border-left-color: #2E8B57 !important; }
body.category-ob-kaisetsusha .-type-list .p-postList__item,
body.category-ob-kaisetsusha .p-postList.-list .p-postList__item { border-left-color: #7B4DAA !important; }
body.category-hoko-iseki .-type-list .p-postList__item,
body.category-hoko-iseki .p-postList.-list .p-postList__item { border-left-color: #E53935 !important; }
body.category-kyudan-joho .-type-list .p-postList__item,
body.category-kyudan-joho .p-postList.-list .p-postList__item { border-left-color: #F9A825 !important; }
body.category-column .-type-list .p-postList__item,
body.category-column .p-postList.-list .p-postList__item { border-left-color: #1A1A1A !important; }

/* ── 404 / 検索 empty のヒント検索サジェスト ── */
body.error404 .l-mainContent::after,
body.search-no-results .l-mainContent::after {
  content: '▸ 記事検索 / トップページに戻る';
  display: block;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: var(--orange);
  text-align: center;
  margin-top: 18px;
}

/* ── 記事冒頭の meta line polish (日付 / コメント数 / カテゴリ) 間隔 ── */
.p-articleMetas.-top > * + * {
  position: relative;
}
.p-articleMetas.-top > *:not(:first-child):not(.p-articleMetas__termList)::before {
  content: '·';
  color: var(--light-gray);
  margin: 0 6px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* ── 記事内 table が横はみ出し時 scroll shadow (見切れ視認) ── */
.post_content .wp-block-table,
.entry-content .wp-block-table,
.post_content .yoshilover-lineup-stats,
.post_content table:not(.wp-block-table) {
  position: relative;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg, var(--white) 30%, rgba(255,255,255,0)) 0 0 / 24px 100% no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0), var(--white) 70%) 100% 0 / 24px 100% no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(26,26,26,0.08), rgba(26,26,26,0)) 0 0 / 12px 100% no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(26,26,26,0), rgba(26,26,26,0.08)) 100% 0 / 12px 100% no-repeat;
  background-attachment: local, local, scroll, scroll;
}

/* ── anchor jump scroll offset (見出しリンク / TOC 先) ── */
h2[id], h3[id], h4[id],
.post_content h2[id],
.post_content h3[id],
.entry-content h2[id],
.entry-content h3[id] {
  scroll-margin-top: 80px;
}
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  h2[id], h3[id], h4[id],
  .post_content h2[id],
  .post_content h3[id],
  .entry-content h2[id],
  .entry-content h3[id] {
    scroll-margin-top: 64px;
  }
}

/* ── a11y: キーボード focus 強化 (focus-visible より強く) ── */
.wp-block-button__link:focus-visible,
.c-btn:focus-visible,
a[href]:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--orange) !important;
  outline-offset: 3px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.22) !important;
}

/* ── footer: social icons 並び強化 (SWELL の footer ソーシャル) ── */
.l-footer .c-iconList,
.l-footer .p-socialList,
.l-footer .wp-block-social-links {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 12px 0 !important;
  list-style: none !important;
}
.l-footer .c-iconList__link,
.l-footer .wp-block-social-link a,
.l-footer .p-socialList a {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06) !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
  transition: background 0.18s, color 0.18s, transform 0.18s !important;
}
.l-footer .c-iconList__link:hover,
.l-footer .wp-block-social-link a:hover,
.l-footer .p-socialList a:hover {
  background: var(--orange) !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

/* ── リード段落 subtle accent (記事本文の最初の p に薄 orange 縦バー) ── */
body.single-post .post_content > p:first-of-type,
body.single-post .entry-content > p:first-of-type {
  padding: 4px 0 4px 12px;
  border-left: 2px solid rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.35);
  margin-left: -4px;
}

/* ── 記事末 まとめ風 「いかがでしたか」box 汎用 (is-style-summary) ── */
.is-style-summary,
.p-articleFoot__summary,
.yoshi-summary-box {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.08) 0%, rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.03) 100%);
  border: 1px solid var(--light-gray);
  border-left: 4px solid var(--orange);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 16px 18px;
  margin: 22px 0 18px;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--black);
  position: relative;
}
.is-style-summary::before,
.p-articleFoot__summary::before,
.yoshi-summary-box::before {
  content: 'SUMMARY';
  position: absolute;
  top: -10px;
  left: 14px;
  background: var(--orange);
  color: var(--white);
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 1.8px;
  padding: 2px 10px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

/* ── コメントエリア (p-commentArea) ── */
.p-commentArea {
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, var(--white), var(--white)),
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.06) 0%, rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.03) 100%);
  background-clip: padding-box, border-box;
  background-origin: padding-box, border-box;
  border: 1px solid var(--light-gray);
  border-top: 4px solid var(--orange);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 22px 22px 18px;
  margin: 28px 0 22px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 14px rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.06);
  position: relative;
}
/* コメント欄全体の hero ribbon (上辺に白抜きマーク) */
.p-commentArea::before {
  content: 'COMMENTS';
  position: absolute;
  top: -12px;
  left: 16px;
  background: var(--orange);
  color: var(--white);
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  padding: 4px 12px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.4);
  line-height: 1;
}
.p-commentArea__title,
.p-commentArea h3,
.p-commentArea .comments-title,
#comments > h2,
#reply-title {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 15px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  letter-spacing: 1.4px !important;
  color: var(--black) !important;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 4px 0 6px 10px !important;
  margin: 0 0 12px !important;
  border-left: 4px solid var(--orange) !important;
  background: transparent !important;
}
/* コメントフォーム 全体 */
.comment-form {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-top: 6px;
}
.comment-form p {
  margin: 0 !important;
  position: relative;
}
.comment-form label {
  display: block;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.4px;
  color: var(--mid-gray);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  transition: color 0.18s;
}
.comment-form p:focus-within label {
  color: var(--orange);
}
/* required マーク * を orange に */
.comment-form label .required,
.comment-form .required {
  color: var(--orange);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-left: 2px;
}
.comment-form input[type="text"],
.comment-form input[type="email"],
.comment-form input[type="url"],
.comment-form textarea {
  width: 100%;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--light-gray) !important;
  border-radius: 4px !important;
  padding: 11px 14px !important;
  background: var(--white) !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  font-family: inherit;
  color: var(--black);
  line-height: 1.5;
  transition: border-color 0.18s, box-shadow 0.18s, background 0.18s !important;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.03);
}
.comment-form input[type="text"]:hover,
.comment-form input[type="email"]:hover,
.comment-form input[type="url"]:hover,
.comment-form textarea:hover {
  border-color: rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.5) !important;
}
.comment-form input[type="text"]:focus,
.comment-form input[type="email"]:focus,
.comment-form input[type="url"]:focus,
.comment-form textarea:focus {
  border-color: var(--orange) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.2) !important;
  background: rgba(255, 243, 232, 0.35) !important;
  outline: none !important;
}
.comment-form textarea {
  min-height: 120px;
  resize: vertical;
  line-height: 1.7;
  padding: 14px 14px !important;
  font-size: 14.5px !important;
}
.comment-form textarea::placeholder,
.comment-form input::placeholder {
  color: rgba(102, 102, 102, 0.5);
  font-weight: 400;
}
/* name / email / url を横並び (desktop, 任意) */
@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .comment-form .comment-form-author,
  .comment-form .comment-form-email,
  .comment-form .comment-form-url {
    display: inline-block;
    width: calc(33.333% - 9px);
    vertical-align: top;
  }
  .comment-form .comment-form-author,
  .comment-form .comment-form-email { margin-right: 12px !important; }
}
/* consent cookies checkbox */
.comment-form .comment-form-cookies-consent {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--mid-gray);
  padding: 6px 0;
}
.comment-form .comment-form-cookies-consent input[type="checkbox"] {
  accent-color: var(--orange);
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  margin: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.comment-form .comment-form-cookies-consent label {
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 12px;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  text-transform: none;
  color: var(--mid-gray);
  margin-bottom: 0;
  font-weight: 400;
  cursor: pointer;
}
/* comment-notes / info block */
.comment-notes,
.logged-in-as,
.must-log-in {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--mid-gray);
  padding: 8px 12px;
  background: rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.03);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--orange);
  border-radius: 2px;
  margin-bottom: 8px !important;
}
.comment-notes a,
.logged-in-as a {
  color: var(--orange) !important;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.comment-form .submit,
#submit {
  background: var(--orange) !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
  border: none !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  padding: 10px 26px !important;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
  letter-spacing: 1.4px !important;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: opacity 0.18s, transform 0.18s;
}
.comment-form .submit:hover,
#submit:hover {
  opacity: 0.9;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.commentlist,
.comment-list {
  list-style: none !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 10px 0 18px !important;
}
.commentlist > li,
.comment-list > li {
  list-style: none !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--light-gray);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--orange);
  padding: 12px 14px !important;
  margin: 0 0 10px !important;
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: 4px;
  transition: border-left-color 0.18s, box-shadow 0.18s, transform 0.18s;
  position: relative;
}
.commentlist > li:hover,
.comment-list > li:hover {
  border-left-color: var(--orange);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.08);
  transform: translateX(1px);
}
/* avatar を左に丸く */
.commentlist .avatar,
.comment-list .avatar,
.comment-author .avatar {
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  border: 2px solid var(--orange);
  padding: 1px;
  background: var(--white);
  float: left;
  margin: 0 12px 6px 0;
}
/* comment meta (author + date) */
.comment-author,
.commentlist .fn,
.comment-list .fn {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px;
  color: var(--black) !important;
}
.comment-author a,
.comment-list .fn a {
  color: var(--black) !important;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.comment-author a:hover,
.comment-list .fn a:hover {
  color: var(--orange) !important;
}
.comment-meta,
.comment-date {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 10px !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.6px;
  color: var(--mid-gray) !important;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.comment-meta a {
  color: var(--mid-gray) !important;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.comment-meta a:hover {
  color: var(--orange) !important;
}
/* comment body text */
.comment-content,
.commentlist p,
.comment-list p {
  font-size: 13.5px !important;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--dark-gray);
  margin: 6px 0 8px !important;
}
/* reply link */
.comment-reply-link {
  display: inline-block;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 10px !important;
  letter-spacing: 1px !important;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  background: rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.1);
  color: var(--orange) !important;
  padding: 3px 10px !important;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.3);
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: background 0.18s, color 0.18s;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.comment-reply-link:hover {
  background: var(--orange);
  color: var(--white) !important;
}
/* nested children (reply to reply) */
.children,
.commentlist .children,
.comment-list .children {
  list-style: none !important;
  padding-left: 20px !important;
  margin-top: 10px !important;
  border-left: 2px dashed rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.3);
}
.children > li {
  border-left-color: #666 !important;
}
/* no comments yet */
.no-comments,
.nocomments {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--mid-gray);
  text-align: center;
  padding: 20px 10px;
  letter-spacing: 0.6px;
  background: rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.04);
  border-radius: 4px;
  border: 1px dashed rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.3);
}
.no-comments::before {
  content: '💬 ';
  margin-right: 4px;
}
/* pingback / trackback items */
.pingback,
.trackback {
  font-size: 12px !important;
  color: var(--mid-gray) !important;
  background: rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.03) !important;
  border-left-color: var(--mid-gray) !important;
}

/* 「コメントをどうぞ」= cancel-comment-reply-link */
#cancel-comment-reply-link {
  display: inline-block;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 1.2px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--mid-gray) !important;
  padding: 3px 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--light-gray);
  border-radius: 999px;
  margin-left: 8px;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: background 0.18s, color 0.18s;
}
#cancel-comment-reply-link:hover {
  background: var(--black);
  color: var(--white) !important;
  border-color: var(--black);
}

/* ── X / Twitter 埋め込み 枠 polish (Twitter widget.js の rendering を阻害しないよう調整) ── */
/* twitter-tweet 自体には overflow/radius つけない (widget.js 化で iframe 差し替わる) */
.wp-block-embed-twitter,
.yoshilover-x-embed {
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: 8px !important;
  /* overflow: visible で iframe resize 許可 */
  overflow: visible !important;
  max-width: 560px !important;
  margin: 20px auto !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  border: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}
.wp-block-embed-twitter > .wp-block-embed__wrapper,
.yoshilover-x-embed {
  padding: 0 !important;
}
.wp-block-embed-twitter:hover,
.yoshilover-x-embed:hover {
  box-shadow: none !important;
}
.twitter-tweet,
blockquote.twitter-tweet {
  display: block !important;
  overflow: visible !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
  margin: 0 auto !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
  border-radius: 0 !important;
}
/* Twitter の widget iframe (platform.twitter.com) を確実に見せる */
iframe.twitter-tweet,
iframe[src*="platform.twitter.com"],
iframe[src*="syndication.twitter.com"],
iframe[id*="twitter-widget"] {
  display: block !important;
  visibility: visible !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
  overflow: visible !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* ── タグ一覧 (記事末) / c-tagList ── */
.c-tagList,
.p-tagList,
.post-tags {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
  margin: 18px 0 12px !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  list-style: none !important;
}
.c-tagList__link,
.p-tagList__link,
.post-tags a,
a[rel="tag"] {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3px;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px !important;
  color: var(--dark-gray) !important;
  background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid var(--light-gray);
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  padding: 3px 11px !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: all 0.18s;
}
.c-tagList__link::before,
.p-tagList__link::before,
.post-tags a::before,
a[rel="tag"]::before {
  content: '#';
  color: var(--orange);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-right: 1px;
}
.c-tagList__link:hover,
.p-tagList__link:hover,
.post-tags a:hover,
a[rel="tag"]:hover {
  background: var(--orange) !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
  border-color: var(--orange) !important;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.c-tagList__link:hover::before,
.p-tagList__link:hover::before,
.post-tags a:hover::before,
a[rel="tag"]:hover::before {
  color: var(--white);
}

/* ── シェア message 「よかったらシェアしてね！」polish ── */
.c-shareBtns__message {
  text-align: center;
  padding-bottom: 10px !important;
  border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.3);
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 11px !important;
  letter-spacing: 1.4px !important;
  color: var(--mid-gray) !important;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.c-shareBtns__message .__text {
  font-family: inherit;
  letter-spacing: inherit;
}
.c-shareBtns__message::before {
  content: '▸ SHARE ';
  color: var(--orange);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.6px;
  margin-right: 4px;
}

/* ── 参照元 / 出典 段落 (hochi.news などのリンク) ── */
.post_content p[style*="font-size:0.8em"],
.entry-content p[style*="font-size:0.8em"] {
  color: var(--mid-gray) !important;
  padding: 8px 12px !important;
  background: rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.03);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--orange);
  border-radius: 2px;
  margin: 14px 0 !important;
}
.post_content p[style*="font-size:0.8em"] a,
.entry-content p[style*="font-size:0.8em"] a {
  color: var(--orange) !important;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: underline !important;
}

/* ── 記事末 「この記事を読んだ人はこちらも」等の見出し ── */
.p-postFooter__title,
.p-related__title,
.wp-block-latest-posts__featured-image + .wp-block-heading {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 15px !important;
  letter-spacing: 1.4px !important;
  color: var(--black) !important;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  border-left: 5px solid var(--orange);
  padding: 4px 0 6px 12px !important;
  margin: 20px 0 12px !important;
  background: transparent !important;
}

/* ── 「ヨシラバー」ブランド強調 (本文中の site 名など) ── */
.post_content :is(b, strong):is(:contains('ヨシラバー')),
.entry-content :is(b, strong) {
  /* :contains is not valid CSS — fallback: no-op */
}

/* ── lineup-stats テーブル (スタメン表) を強化 ── */
.yoshilover-lineup-stats {
  background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid var(--light-gray);
  border-top: 3px solid var(--orange);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  margin: 16px 0;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.04);
}
.yoshilover-lineup-stats table {
  margin: 0 !important;
  border: none !important;
  font-size: 12.5px !important;
}
.yoshilover-lineup-stats th {
  background: var(--black) !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 10.5px !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.6px;
  padding: 6px 8px !important;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.yoshilover-lineup-stats td {
  padding: 5px 8px !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--light-gray) !important;
}
.yoshilover-lineup-stats tbody tr:hover {
  background: var(--orange-light) !important;
}

/* ── 記事末 yoshi-x-follow-cta mobile レスポンシブ ── */
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .yoshi-x-follow-cta {
    flex-direction: column;
    text-align: center;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 12px 14px;
  }
  .yoshi-x-follow-cta__btn { padding: 8px 20px !important; }
}

/* header を最前面に確保 (広告より上に表示) */
.l-header,
.l-header__inner,
.l-header__bar {
  z-index: 9999 !important;
}

/* ── 記事本文 drop cap (最初の段落の先頭 1 文字を大きく) ── */
/* single post のみ、最初の p の最初の文字 (opt-in は body class 方式) */
body.single-post .post_content > p:first-of-type::first-letter,
body.single-post .entry-content > p:first-of-type::first-letter {
  float: left;
  font-family: 'Oswald', serif;
  font-size: 3.2em;
  line-height: 0.9;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--orange);
  padding: 4px 8px 0 0;
  margin-right: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--orange) 0%, #E06010 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  body.single-post .post_content > p:first-of-type::first-letter,
  body.single-post .entry-content > p:first-of-type::first-letter {
    font-size: 2.6em;
  }
}

/* ── 記事本文の画像 drop shadow + 縁 ── */
.post_content .wp-block-image img,
.entry-content .wp-block-image img,
.post_content .wp-block-image figure,
.post_content img:not(.avatar):not(.c-cat-label img):not([class*="emoji"]) {
  border-radius: 4px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.08);
}
.post_content .wp-block-image:hover img,
.entry-content .wp-block-image:hover img {
  box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.16);
  transition: box-shadow 0.25s ease;
}

/* ── 強調引用 (大きく目立つ pull-quote) as helper .pull-quote ── */
.post_content .pull-quote,
.entry-content .pull-quote,
.is-style-pull-quote {
  position: relative;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.08) 0%, rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.02) 100%);
  border: none;
  border-top: 3px solid var(--orange);
  border-bottom: 3px solid var(--orange);
  padding: 20px 24px !important;
  margin: 24px 0;
  font-size: 1.15em;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--black);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-style: normal;
  text-align: center;
}
.post_content .pull-quote::before,
.entry-content .pull-quote::before,
.is-style-pull-quote::before {
  content: '\201C';
  position: absolute;
  top: -8px;
  left: 16px;
  background: var(--white);
  padding: 0 6px;
  font-family: 'Oswald', Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 28px;
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--orange);
}

/* ── スマホヘッダ swiper メニュー (運営者会社・仕事依頼 / お問合せ) を非表示 ── */
/* p-spHeadMenu = l-header__spNav 配下の横スクロール swiper、今は不要項目のみ */
.l-header__spNav,
.p-spHeadMenu,
ul.p-spHeadMenu,
.l-header .swiper-slide.menu-item-55464,
.l-header .swiper-slide.menu-item-55465,
.menu-item-55464,
.menu-item-55465 {
  display: none !important;
  visibility: hidden !important;
  height: 0 !important;
  max-height: 0 !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  border: 0 !important;
}
/* header が sticky で自前 bg が無いと透ける問題対応 */
.l-header,
.l-header__inner {
  background-color: var(--black) !important;
}
/* もし「半透明ヘッダ」にしたい場合は以下 class を body/html に付ける (オプション) */
body.yoshi-header-translucent .l-header,
body.yoshi-header-translucent .l-header__inner {
  background-color: rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.82) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}

/* ── 目次 (p-toc) ── */
.p-toc {
  background: var(--white) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--light-gray) !important;
  border-top: 4px solid var(--orange) !important;
  border-radius: 3px !important;
  padding: 12px 16px 14px !important;
  margin: 18px 0 22px !important;

}
.p-toc__ttl {

  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  letter-spacing: 1.4px !important;
  color: var(--black) !important;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 2px 0 6px 0 !important;
  margin-bottom: 6px !important;
  border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.3);
  background: transparent !important;
}
.p-toc__ttl::before {
  content: '';
  display: inline-block;
  width: 4px;
  height: 14px;
  background: var(--orange);
  border-radius: 1px;
}
.p-toc ol,
.p-toc ul {
  list-style: none !important;
  margin: 6px 0 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}
.p-toc li {
  position: relative;
  margin: 0 0 4px !important;
  padding: 0 0 0 14px !important;
  line-height: 1.55 !important;
}
.p-toc li::before {
  content: '▸';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  color: var(--orange);
  font-size: 12px;
}
.p-toc a {
  color: var(--black) !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  border-bottom: 1px dashed transparent;

.p-toc a:hover {

  border-bottom-color: var(--orange);
}

/* ── シェアボタン (c-shareBtns) ── */
.c-shareBtns {
  margin: 22px 0 18px !important;
}
.c-shareBtns__message {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;

.c-pagerPosts > a,
.p-postNav > a,

  border-left: 3px solid transparent !important;
  border-radius: 3px !important;
  padding: 12px 14px !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: border-left-color 0.18s, background 0.18s, transform 0.18s !important;
  min-height: 72px;
}
.p-pagerPosts > a:hover,
.c-pagerPosts > a:hover,
.p-postNav > a:hover {
  background: var(--orange-light) !important;
  border-left-color: var(--orange) !important;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.p-pagerPosts .__label,
.p-postNav .__label,
.p-pagerPosts__label {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 10px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  letter-spacing: 1.6px !important;
  color: var(--orange) !important;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.p-pagerPosts .__title,
.p-postNav .__title,
.p-pagerPosts__title {
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
  font-size: 13px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  line-height: 1.45 !important;
  color: var(--black) !important;
  margin-top: 3px;
}

/* ── アーカイブページ h1 (c-pageTitle) を hero 化 ── */
/* カテゴリ / タグ / 月別 / 検索結果 すべて共通 */
.c-pageTitle {
  font-size: clamp(18px, 3.4vw, 22px) !important;
  line-height: 1.4 !important;
  position: relative;
  padding: 14px 16px !important;
  margin-bottom: 18px !important;
  background: var(--black) !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
  border-left: 6px solid var(--orange) !important;
  border-radius: 2px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.12);
  font-weight: 800 !important;
}
.c-pageTitle[data-style="b_bottom"] {
  border-bottom: none !important;
}
.c-pageTitle__inner {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: baseline !important;
  gap: 10px;
  border-bottom: none !important;
  float: none !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
}
.c-pageTitle__subTitle {
  font-style: normal !important;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 10px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  letter-spacing: 1.8px !important;
  color: var(--orange) !important;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  background: rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.12);
  border: 1px solid rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.4);
  border-radius: 999px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* ── eyecatch / サムネイル hover zoom ── */
/* 記事詳細の eyecatch は既に orange 下辺アクセント済、ここでは画像 zoom のみ */
/* 一覧サムネイル + 記事詳細 eyecatch の両方 */
.p-articleThumb,
.p-entryEyeCatch,
.p-postList__eyecatch,
.c-postThumb,
.p-postList__thumb {
  overflow: hidden;
}
.p-articleThumb .p-articleThumb__img,
.p-entryEyeCatch .p-entryEyeCatch__img,
.p-postList__eyecatch img,
.p-postList__thumb img,
.c-postThumb__img {
  transition: transform 0.35s ease, filter 0.35s ease !important;
}
.p-articleThumb:hover .p-articleThumb__img,
.p-entryEyeCatch:hover .p-entryEyeCatch__img,
.p-postList__item:hover .p-postList__eyecatch img,
.p-postList__item:hover .p-postList__thumb img,
.p-postList__item:hover .c-postThumb__img {
  transform: scale(1.045);
  filter: saturate(1.08);
}

/* ── アイキャッチ 16:9 ratio lock (記事一覧型カード・サムネイル) ── */
/* list 型 (横並び) は既に 120×80 で固定なので対象外、card / grid 型だけに */
.-type-card .p-postList__eyecatch,
.p-postList.-card .p-postList__eyecatch,
.-type-grid .p-postList__eyecatch,
.p-postList.-grid .p-postList__eyecatch {
  position: relative;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: auto !important;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.-type-card .p-postList__eyecatch img,
.p-postList.-card .p-postList__eyecatch img,
.-type-grid .p-postList__eyecatch img,
.p-postList.-grid .p-postList__eyecatch img {
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  object-fit: cover !important;
}
/* カード eyecatch に hover で orange オーバーレイ 0.18 */
.-type-card .p-postList__item,
.p-postList.-card .p-postList__item,
.-type-grid .p-postList__item,
.p-postList.-grid .p-postList__item {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.-type-card .p-postList__eyecatch::after,
.p-postList.-card .p-postList__eyecatch::after,
.-type-grid .p-postList__eyecatch::after,
.p-postList.-grid .p-postList__eyecatch::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(26, 26, 26, 0) 55%, rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.38) 100%);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.22s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.-type-card .p-postList__item:hover .p-postList__eyecatch::after,
.p-postList.-card .p-postList__item:hover .p-postList__eyecatch::after,
.-type-grid .p-postList__item:hover .p-postList__eyecatch::after,
.p-postList.-grid .p-postList__item:hover .p-postList__eyecatch::after {
  opacity: 1;
}

/* ── c-cat-label (記事詳細 + 一覧) を巨人圧化 ── */
/* 既存の background-color (カテゴリ色) は line 327+ で設定済、ここでは formatting のみ */
.c-cat-label,
.cat-label,
.p-postList__cats .c-cat-label,
.p-articleMetas__termList .c-categoryList__link {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 10px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  letter-spacing: 1px !important;
  padding: 3px 10px !important;
  border-radius: 2px !important;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--white) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
  line-height: 1.5;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}
.c-cat-label:hover,
.p-postList__cats .c-cat-label:hover,
.p-articleMetas__termList .c-categoryList__link:hover {
  opacity: 0.9;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  transition: transform 0.18s, opacity 0.18s;
}
/* 記事詳細 eyecatch の上に cat-label を浮かせる版 */
.p-articleThumb > .c-cat-label,
.p-entryEyeCatch > .c-cat-label,
.p-articleThumb .c-cat-label {
  position: absolute;
  top: 10px;
  left: 10px;
  z-index: 2;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.28);
}

/* ── 404 / 検索結果 empty state ── */
.p-404,
.p-notFound,
.p-search__noResult,
.p-search .no-results,
body.error404 .l-mainContent,
body.search-no-results .l-mainContent {
  text-align: center;
}
body.error404 .c-pageTitle,
body.search-no-results .c-pageTitle {
  /* 既存 hero スタイル維持、text-align は中央寄せ */
  justify-content: center;
}
.p-404 h1,
.p-404 h2,
.p-notFound h1,
.p-notFound h2 {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
  font-size: clamp(36px, 9vw, 64px) !important;
  letter-spacing: 2px !important;
  color: var(--black) !important;
  margin: 18px 0 8px !important;
}
.p-404 h1::before,
.p-notFound h1::before {
  content: '404';
  display: block;
  font-size: clamp(60px, 18vw, 140px);
  color: var(--orange);
  line-height: 1;
  opacity: 0.9;
  letter-spacing: 4px;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.p-404__desc,
.p-notFound__desc,
.p-search__noResult p,
body.error404 .l-mainContent p {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--mid-gray);
  line-height: 1.8;
  max-width: 480px;
  margin: 12px auto 18px;
}
/* empty state の検索フォームを目立たせる */
body.error404 .c-searchForm,
body.search-no-results .c-searchForm,
.p-404 .c-searchForm,
.p-notFound .c-searchForm {
  max-width: 420px;
  margin: 16px auto 28px;
  border: 2px solid var(--orange);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 2px 4px 2px 14px;
  background: var(--white);
}

/* ── X フォロー CTA バー (記事末、wrappable) ── */
/* 用途: 記事末の「X フォローしてね」ブロック。既存 inline HTML は無いが、        */
/*      .yoshi-x-follow-cta クラスの div を将来差し込めば巨人圧で光る            */
.yoshi-x-follow-cta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  background: var(--black);
  border-left: 5px solid var(--orange);
  border-radius: 3px;
  color: var(--white);
  margin: 22px 0 20px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.22);
}
.yoshi-x-follow-cta__logo {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 24px;
  color: var(--orange);
  line-height: 1;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.yoshi-x-follow-cta__body {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}
.yoshi-x-follow-cta__lead {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 1.5px;
  color: var(--orange);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}
.yoshi-x-follow-cta__title {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: var(--white);
}
.yoshi-x-follow-cta__btn {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  background: var(--orange);
  color: var(--white) !important;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.6px;
  font-size: 12px;
  padding: 8px 18px !important;
  border-radius: 999px;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: transform 0.18s, opacity 0.18s;
}
.yoshi-x-follow-cta__btn:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  opacity: 0.92;
}

/* ── inline 「💬 みんなの本音は？」 button を巨人 pill に統一 ── */
/* 記事末に出る inline-style button の宿命、対象は a[href="#respond"] 全般 */
.wp-block-button__link[href*="#respond"],
a.wp-block-button__link[href^="#respond"],
a[href="#respond"].wp-block-button__link {
  background-color: var(--orange) !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.8px !important;
}

/* ── ホーム p-postList の card 感強化 (is-yoshi-front-density JS が有効な前提) ── */
/* JS で is-yoshi-front-density が付いた li を狙う */
.p-postList__item.is-yoshi-front-density {
  border-left: 3px solid var(--orange);
}
.p-postList__item.is-yoshi-front-density:hover {
  border-left-width: 4px;
}
/* subtype 別 border accent (JS が is-yoshi-subtype-* を付ける) */
.p-postList__item.is-yoshi-subtype-lineup { border-left-color: var(--blue); }
.p-postList__item.is-yoshi-subtype-postgame { border-left-color: #50555b; }
.p-postList__item.is-yoshi-subtype-notice { border-left-color: #ba2c3f; }
.p-postList__item.is-yoshi-subtype-probable_starter,
.p-postList__item.is-yoshi-subtype-pregame { border-left-color: #5e6b7a; }
.p-postList__item.is-yoshi-subtype-live_update { border-left-color: var(--orange); }

/* ── 日付 c-postTimes を Oswald 固定 ── */
.c-postTimes,
.c-postTimes__posted,
.c-postTimes__modified,
.p-postList__times,
.c-meta__date {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.c-postTimes__posted.icon-posted::before,
.c-postTimes__modified.icon-modified::before {
  color: var(--orange);
}

/* ── コメント数 c-meta__comment / __comment pill 化 ── */
.p-postList__comment,
.c-meta__comment,
.post-comments-count {
  background: rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.1);
  border: 1px solid rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.28);
  color: var(--orange) !important;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 10px !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.6px !important;
  padding: 1px 8px !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  margin-left: 6px !important;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* 記事詳細の eyecatch は既に orange 下辺 / hover zoom 済。幅はテーマに従う */

/* ── カテゴリ別アクセント (body class に応じた h2 / page title / eyecatch 左バー) ── */
/* 試合速報 (shiai-sokuho) = orange (default) */
body.category-shiai-sokuho .c-pageTitle,
body.single-post.category-shiai-sokuho .p-articleThumb,
body.category-shiai-sokuho .p-articleHead.c-postTitle { border-left-color: #F5811F !important; }
body.category-shiai-sokuho .post_content h2,
body.category-shiai-sokuho .entry-content h2 { border-left-color: #F5811F !important; }

/* 選手情報 (senshu-joho) = blue */
body.category-senshu-joho .c-pageTitle,
body.single-post.category-senshu-joho .p-articleThumb,
body.category-senshu-joho .p-articleHead.c-postTitle { border-left-color: #003DA5 !important; }
body.category-senshu-joho .post_content h2,
body.category-senshu-joho .entry-content h2 { border-left-color: #003DA5 !important; }
body.category-senshu-joho .p-articleThumb { border-bottom-color: #003DA5 !important; }

/* 首脳陣 (syuno) = dark gray */
body.category-syuno .c-pageTitle,
body.single-post.category-syuno .p-articleThumb,
body.category-syuno .p-articleHead.c-postTitle { border-left-color: #555555 !important; }
body.category-syuno .post_content h2,
body.category-syuno .entry-content h2 { border-left-color: #555555 !important; }
body.category-syuno .p-articleThumb { border-bottom-color: #555555 !important; }

/* ドラフト・育成 (draft-ikusei) = green */
body.category-draft-ikusei .c-pageTitle,
body.single-post.category-draft-ikusei .p-articleThumb,
body.category-draft-ikusei .p-articleHead.c-postTitle { border-left-color: #2E8B57 !important; }
body.category-draft-ikusei .post_content h2,
body.category-draft-ikusei .entry-content h2 { border-left-color: #2E8B57 !important; }
body.category-draft-ikusei .p-articleThumb { border-bottom-color: #2E8B57 !important; }

/* OB・解説者 (ob-kaisetsusha) = purple */
body.category-ob-kaisetsusha .c-pageTitle,
body.single-post.category-ob-kaisetsusha .p-articleThumb,
body.category-ob-kaisetsusha .p-articleHead.c-postTitle { border-left-color: #7B4DAA !important; }
body.category-ob-kaisetsusha .post_content h2,
body.category-ob-kaisetsusha .entry-content h2 { border-left-color: #7B4DAA !important; }
body.category-ob-kaisetsusha .p-articleThumb { border-bottom-color: #7B4DAA !important; }

/* 補強・移籍 (hoko-iseki) = red */
body.category-hoko-iseki .c-pageTitle,
body.single-post.category-hoko-iseki .p-articleThumb,
body.category-hoko-iseki .p-articleHead.c-postTitle { border-left-color: #E53935 !important; }
body.category-hoko-iseki .post_content h2,
body.category-hoko-iseki .entry-content h2 { border-left-color: #E53935 !important; }
body.category-hoko-iseki .p-articleThumb { border-bottom-color: #E53935 !important; }

/* 球団情報 (kyudan-joho) = gold */
body.category-kyudan-joho .c-pageTitle,
body.single-post.category-kyudan-joho .p-articleThumb,
body.category-kyudan-joho .p-articleHead.c-postTitle { border-left-color: #F9A825 !important; }
body.category-kyudan-joho .post_content h2,
body.category-kyudan-joho .entry-content h2 { border-left-color: #F9A825 !important; }
body.category-kyudan-joho .p-articleThumb { border-bottom-color: #F9A825 !important; }

/* コラム (column) = black */
body.category-column .c-pageTitle,
body.single-post.category-column .p-articleThumb,
body.category-column .p-articleHead.c-postTitle { border-left-color: #1A1A1A !important; }
body.category-column .post_content h2,
body.category-column .entry-content h2 { border-left-color: #1A1A1A !important; }

/* ── プラス: tag archive page 用ヘッダ tint ── */
body.tag .c-pageTitle { border-left-color: var(--orange) !important; }
body.tag .c-pageTitle__subTitle::before {
  content: '#';
  color: var(--orange);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-right: 2px;
}

/* ── 著者ページ用ヘッダ tint ── */
body.author .c-pageTitle { border-left-color: var(--black) !important; }

/* ── 月別ページ (date archive) 用 ── */
body.date .c-pageTitle { border-left-color: var(--mid-gray) !important; }

/* ── テキスト選択色を巨人オレンジに ── */
::selection {
  background: rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.45);
  color: var(--black);
}
::-moz-selection {
  background: rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.45);
  color: var(--black);
}

/* ── グローバル focus ring (a11y + 巨人色) ── */
a:focus-visible,
button:focus-visible,
input:focus-visible,
textarea:focus-visible,
select:focus-visible,
[tabindex]:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--orange);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  border-radius: 2px;
}

/* ── strong marker の scope 絞り (見出し / table / button / badge 系では発動させない) ── */
.post_content h1 strong, .post_content h2 strong, .post_content h3 strong,
.post_content h4 strong, .post_content h5 strong, .post_content h6 strong,
.entry-content h1 strong, .entry-content h2 strong, .entry-content h3 strong,
.entry-content h4 strong, .entry-content h5 strong, .entry-content h6 strong,
.post_content table strong, .entry-content table strong,
.post_content .wp-block-button strong, .entry-content .wp-block-button strong,
.post_content .c-cat-label strong,
.post_content code strong, .post_content pre strong {
  background: transparent !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  color: inherit !important;
  font-weight: inherit !important;
}

/* ── スクロールバー tint (Chrome/Edge/Safari) ── */
::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 10px; height: 10px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.55);
  border-radius: 999px;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: var(--orange); }
::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.05); }

/* ── print 最小 ── */
@media print {
  .l-header, .l-footer, .l-sidebar, .p-fixBottomMenu,
  .yoshi-breaking-strip, .yoshi-topic-hub, .yoshi-article-bundles,
  .yoshi-sns-reactions, .c-shareBtns, .p-commentArea { display: none !important; }
  .post_content, .entry-content { font-size: 12pt; line-height: 1.7; color: #000; }
  a { color: #000 !important; text-decoration: underline !important; }
}

/* ── reduced motion 尊重 ── */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
  }
}

/* ── モバイル header shrink (SWELL default の logo padding 16px 0 を殺す) ── */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  /* キャッチコピー完全非表示 (全セレクタ) */
  .l-header .c-catchphrase,
  .l-header__bar .c-catchphrase,
  .l-header__logo .c-catchphrase,
  .l-header .p-headerLogo__catch,
  .l-header .c-logo__desc,
  .l-header .p-logo__desc { display: none !important; }

  /* 真犯人: SWELL の .l-header__logo { padding: 16px 0 } を潰す */
  .l-header__logo {
    padding: 4px 2vw !important;
    line-height: 1 !important;
  }
  /* .l-header__inner SWELL が 8px 8px pad 設定、さらに詰める */
  .l-header__inner {
    padding-top: 2px !important;
    padding-bottom: 2px !important;
    min-height: 44px !important;
  }
  /* 下段 (gnav / bar) */
  .l-header__barInner {
    min-height: 36px !important;
    padding-top: 2px !important;
    padding-bottom: 2px !important;
  }
  /* header 全体 max-height でキャップ (保険) */
  .l-header:not(.-fixed) {
    max-height: 56px;
  }
  /* logo 文字 small */
  .l-header .c-logo__text,
  .l-header .site-name-text,
  .l-header .p-logo__title {
    font-size: 16px !important;
    letter-spacing: 1.2px !important;
    line-height: 1.1 !important;
  }
  /* logo image 高さ */
  .l-header .c-logo img,
  .l-header .p-logo img {
    max-height: 30px !important;
    width: auto;
  }
  /* header border-bottom 薄く */
  .l-header { border-bottom-width: 3px !important; }
  /* sp ハンバーガー/カスタムボタン タップ領域 */
  .l-header__menuBtn,
  .l-header__customBtn {
    height: 44px !important;
    width: 44px !important;
    line-height: 1 !important;
  }
  /* gnav (header下のカテゴリ帯) も 1 段圧縮 */
  .c-gnav, .l-gnav, .p-gnav { padding: 0 !important; }
  .c-gnav__item > a,
  .l-gnav__item > a,
  .p-gnav__item > a { padding: 8px 10px !important; font-size: 12px !important; }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
