a[href*="/feed/"]::before {
  content: '📡';
  font-size: 12px;
}

/* ====================================================================
   Pinned / Sticky post (sticky class が WP から付く)
   ==================================================================== */
.sticky,
article.sticky,
.post.sticky,
.p-postList__item.sticky {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.05) 0%, var(--white) 100%) !important;
  border-left: 4px solid var(--orange) !important;
  position: relative;
}
.sticky::before,
article.sticky::before,
.p-postList__item.sticky::before {
  content: '📌 PINNED';
  position: absolute;
  top: 6px;
  right: 8px;
  background: var(--orange);
  color: var(--white);
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.4px;
  padding: 2px 7px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  z-index: 2;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

/* ====================================================================
   Newsletter signup form helper (X / Mailchimp 等で使える)
   ==================================================================== */
.yoshi-newsletter {
  background: var(--black);
  color: var(--white);
  padding: 18px 20px;
  border-top: 4px solid var(--orange);
  border-radius: 4px;
  margin: 20px 0;
  text-align: center;
}
.yoshi-newsletter__label {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 1.8px;
  color: var(--orange);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.yoshi-newsletter__title {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.4;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.yoshi-newsletter__form {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
  max-width: 420px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}
.yoshi-newsletter__input {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  color: var(--white);
  border-radius: 999px 0 0 999px;
  font-size: 14px;
}
.yoshi-newsletter__input::placeholder { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45); }
.yoshi-newsletter__input:focus {
  border-color: var(--orange);
  outline: none;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
}
.yoshi-newsletter__btn {
  background: var(--orange);
  color: var(--white);
  border: none;
  padding: 10px 20px;
  border-radius: 0 999px 999px 0;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 13px;
  letter-spacing: 0.8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  transition: opacity 0.18s;
}
.yoshi-newsletter__btn:hover { opacity: 0.9; }

/* ====================================================================
   画面上部の固定 banner (試合日限定、DOM 注入で出す用)
   ==================================================================== */
.yoshi-top-banner {
  position: sticky;
  top: 56px;
  z-index: 99;
  background: var(--orange);
  color: var(--white);
  padding: 6px 14px;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  text-align: center;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.32);
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .yoshi-top-banner {
    top: 48px;
    font-size: 10px;
  }
}

/* ====================================================================
   コメント数 / シェア数 大型 display (記事 header 上に出す用)
   ==================================================================== */
.yoshi-stat-bar {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-around;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  background: var(--bg);
  border-radius: 3px;
  margin: 12px 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--light-gray);
}
.yoshi-stat-bar__item {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
}
.yoshi-stat-bar__num {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--orange);
  line-height: 1;
}
.yoshi-stat-bar__label {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 1.2px;
  color: var(--mid-gray);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* ====================================================================
   画像 + 文字 並び card (SWELL wp-block-media-text)
   ==================================================================== */
.wp-block-media-text {
  border: 1px solid var(--light-gray) !important;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--orange) !important;
  border-radius: 3px !important;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 18px 0 !important;
  background: var(--white);
}
.wp-block-media-text__content {
  padding: 14px 18px !important;
}

/* ====================================================================
   カウント アップ アニメ (実際の数値は JS で動かす、CSS 側は準備)
   ==================================================================== */
.yoshi-counter-up {
  display: inline-block;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--orange);
  transition: transform 0.25s ease;
}
.yoshi-counter-up.is-animating {
  animation: yoshiloCountBounce 0.4s ease;
}
@keyframes yoshiloCountBounce {
  0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
  50% { transform: scale(1.08); }
}

/* ====================================================================
   SWELL 実 DOM 追加カバー (cached HTML から拾った未スタイル class)
   ==================================================================== */

/* c-headLogo (ヘッダ logo wrapper) */
.c-headLogo {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  line-height: 1;
}
.c-headLogo__link {
  color: var(--white) !important;
  text-decoration: none;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
}

/* c-iconBtn (アイコンボタン、ハンバーガー等) */
.c-iconBtn {
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: opacity 0.18s, color 0.18s;
}
.c-iconBtn:hover { opacity: 0.85; }
.c-iconBtn__icon {
  color: inherit;
}
.c-plainBtn {
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* l-articleBottom (記事下セクション群) */
.l-articleBottom {
  margin-top: 24px;
}
.l-articleBottom__section {
  margin-bottom: 22px;
}
.l-articleBottom__title {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 15px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  letter-spacing: 1.4px !important;
  color: var(--black) !important;
  padding: 4px 0 6px 12px !important;
  margin: 0 0 12px !important;
  border-left: 5px solid var(--orange) !important;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  background: transparent !important;
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .l-articleBottom {
    margin-top: 18px;
  }
  .l-articleBottom__section {
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }
  .l-articleBottom__title {
    font-size: 13.5px !important;
    padding: 3px 0 5px 10px !important;
    border-left-width: 4px !important;
    margin-bottom: 10px !important;
  }
}

/* p-spMenu (SWELL mobile full-screen menu) */
.p-spMenu {
  background: var(--black) !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
}
.p-spMenu__overlay {
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
}
.p-spMenu__body,
.p-spMenu__inner {
  background: var(--black) !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
}
.p-spMenu__nav .menu-item a {
  color: var(--white) !important;
  padding: 12px 18px !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) !important;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 13px;
  letter-spacing: 0.8px;
  transition: background 0.18s, color 0.18s, padding-left 0.18s;
}
.p-spMenu__nav .menu-item a:hover,
.p-spMenu__nav .menu-item.current-menu-item a {
  background: rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.14) !important;
  color: var(--orange) !important;
  padding-left: 22px !important;
}
.p-spMenu__closeBtn {
  color: var(--orange) !important;
  font-size: 24px !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
  padding: 8px !important;
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

/* p-searchModal (検索モーダル) */
.p-searchModal {
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
}
.p-searchModal__inner {
  background: var(--black) !important;
  border-radius: 4px;
  border-top: 4px solid var(--orange);
  padding: 20px;
  max-width: 520px;
  width: 92%;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
}

/* p-indexModal (メニュー index モーダル) */
.p-indexModal {
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
}
.p-indexModal__inner {
  background: var(--white) !important;
  border-radius: 4px;
  border-top: 4px solid var(--orange);
  padding: 20px;
}

/* c-fixBtn (画面下に追従する iconic button) */
.c-fixBtn {
  background: var(--orange) !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
  border: none !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.3) !important;
  transition: transform 0.18s, box-shadow 0.18s;
}
.c-fixBtn:hover {
  background: var(--black) !important;
  color: var(--orange) !important;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.3) !important;
}
.c-fixBtn__icon {
  color: inherit;
  line-height: 1;
}
.p-fixBtnWrap {
  bottom: max(14px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) !important;
}

/* c-urlcopy (URL をコピーした時の toast) */
.c-urlcopy,
.c-copyedPoppup {
  background: var(--black) !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
  border-radius: 3px !important;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--orange) !important;
  padding: 10px 14px !important;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 12px !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.8px;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) !important;
}
.c-urlcopy__content {
  font-family: inherit;
  color: inherit;
}

/* c-modal (SWELL 汎用 modal) */
.c-modal {
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
}
.c-modal__close {
  color: var(--orange) !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
  font-size: 22px !important;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  transition: color 0.18s, transform 0.18s;
}
.c-modal__close:hover {
  color: var(--white) !important;
  transform: rotate(90deg);
}

/* c-overlay (汎用 overlay) */
.c-overlay {
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
}

/* c-listMenu (list menu ナビ) */
.c-listMenu {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
}
.c-listMenu > li > a {
  display: block;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--dark-gray) !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--light-gray);
  transition: background 0.18s, padding-left 0.18s, color 0.18s;
}
.c-listMenu > li > a:hover {
  background: var(--orange-light) !important;
  color: var(--orange) !important;
  padding-left: 18px;
}

/* l-scrollObserver (内部観測用 placeholder、見た目 0) */
.l-scrollObserver {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0 0 0 0);
}

/* c-iconList__item / __icon (SWELL social icons 等) */
.c-iconList {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 4px;
}
.c-iconList__item {
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.c-iconList__icon {
  font-size: 16px;
  color: currentColor;
}

/* p-breadcrumb__text (パン屑の補助) */
.p-breadcrumb__text {
  color: inherit;
}

/* u-bg-main / u-fz-14 等 utility class */
.u-bg-main { background: var(--orange) !important; }
.u-fz-14 { font-size: 14px !important; }

/* c-shareBtns__icon (シェアボタン中の icon) */
.c-shareBtns__icon {
  font-size: 16px;
  color: inherit;
  margin-right: 4px;
}

/* ====================================================================
   デスクトップ home top 見た目 refinement
   ==================================================================== */
@media (min-width: 1024px) {
  /* home の yoshi-topic-hub を 4col に強制 (480px min → auto-fit は 3col 弱) */
  body.home .yoshi-topic-hub__items {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr) !important;
  }
  /* デスクトップ home の widget_recent_entries リスト最大 6 件表示風 (実際は WP option で制御) */
  body.home .w-frontTop .widget_recent_entries > ul > li {
    border-radius: 3px;
  }
}

/* ====================================================================
   PC マウス hover 時の card ripple 風アニメ (desktop only)
   ==================================================================== */
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) and (min-width: 1024px) {
  .yoshi-topic-hub__item,
  .yoshi-article-bundles__item,
  .p-postList__item {
    transition: transform 0.22s ease, box-shadow 0.22s ease, background 0.22s ease;
  }
  .yoshi-topic-hub__item:hover,
  .yoshi-article-bundles__item:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.01);
  }
}

/* ====================================================================
   記事詳細 上部の 「この記事は約X分で読めます」 chip 配置 helper
   ==================================================================== */
.yoshi-meta-line {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px 12px;
  padding: 6px 0 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--light-gray);
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--mid-gray);
  letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}
.yoshi-meta-line > * {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3px;
}
.yoshi-meta-line .-date { color: var(--orange); }
.yoshi-meta-line .-author { color: var(--black); font-weight: 700; }
.yoshi-meta-line .-read-time { color: var(--mid-gray); }
.yoshi-meta-line .-comment-count { color: var(--orange); }

/* ====================================================================
   投稿 / カテゴリ ページ の 広告 (広告コード挿入位置) 完全抑制
   ==================================================================== */
.l-article__ad,
.l-post__ad,
.l-category__ad,
.l-archive__ad,
.p-article__ad-top,
.p-article__ad-middle,
.p-article__ad-bottom {
  display: none !important;
}

/* ====================================================================
   画面外 要素 (aria-hidden=true) は clip
   ==================================================================== */
[aria-hidden="true"]:not([class*="yoshi"]):not(.swell-block-*) {
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* ====================================================================
   巨人 ロゴ 風 text logo (YOSHILOVER / 巨人)
   ==================================================================== */
.yoshi-brand-logo {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  color: var(--white);
  font-size: 20px;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.yoshi-brand-logo__text {
  color: var(--white);
}
.yoshi-brand-logo__text strong {
  color: var(--orange);
}
.yoshi-brand-logo__badge {
  background: var(--orange);
  color: var(--white);
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* ====================================================================
   補助: 右下 floating CTA (fixed button、「トップへ戻る」補助)
   ==================================================================== */
.yoshi-fab {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: max(80px, calc(60px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)));
  right: 12px;
  z-index: 90;
  background: var(--orange);
  color: var(--white);
  border-radius: 999px;
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.4);
  transition: transform 0.18s, box-shadow 0.18s;
  font-size: 20px;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.yoshi-fab:hover {
  transform: scale(1.08);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.5);
}

/* ====================================================================
   「文字サイズ切替」 button style (CSS-only state は JS で toggle)
   ==================================================================== */
body.yoshi-font-large {
  --yoshi-body-size: 17px;
}
body.yoshi-font-large .post_content,
body.yoshi-font-large .entry-content {
  font-size: var(--yoshi-body-size) !important;
  line-height: 1.9 !important;
}
body.yoshi-font-xlarge .post_content,
body.yoshi-font-xlarge .entry-content {
  font-size: 18px !important;
  line-height: 1.95 !important;
}

/* ── モバイル 投稿/固定ページの上部 (breadcrumb / metas / title / eyecatch) 間隔圧縮 ── */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  /* パン屑 padding 圧縮 + 文字小 */
  .p-breadcrumb {
    padding: 4px 0 6px !important;
    font-size: 10.5px !important;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px !important;
  }
  /* 記事上部 metas (category + 日付) */
  .p-articleMetas.-top {
    margin-bottom: 6px !important;
    gap: 4px 10px !important;
  }
  /* 記事タイトルをさらに絞る (batch 24 の上書き) */
  .p-articleHead.c-postTitle,
  .c-postTitle {
    padding: 8px 0 9px 10px !important;
    margin-bottom: 8px !important;
    border-left-width: 4px !important;
  }
  .c-postTitle__ttl {
    font-size: clamp(16px, 4.2vw, 19px) !important;
    line-height: 1.38 !important;
    font-weight: 800 !important;
  }
  .c-postTitle__date {
    font-size: 11px !important;
    margin-top: 4px;
  }
  /* eyecatch は画面の 38% 最大にキャップ (縦方向で取りすぎないよう) */
  .p-articleThumb,
  .p-entryEyeCatch {
    max-height: 38vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 10px !important;
    border-bottom-width: 2px !important;
  }
  .p-articleThumb__img,
  .p-entryEyeCatch__img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    max-height: 38vh;
  }
  /* 記事本文の最初の段落も上余白少なめ */
  .post_content > p:first-child,
  .entry-content > p:first-child {
    margin-top: 0 !important;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .p-breadcrumb { padding: 3px 0 5px !important; font-size: 10px !important; }
  .c-postTitle__ttl { font-size: clamp(15px, 4.2vw, 17px) !important; line-height: 1.38 !important; }
  .p-articleThumb, .p-entryEyeCatch {
    max-height: 34vh;
    margin-bottom: 8px !important;
  }
  .p-articleThumb__img, .p-entryEyeCatch__img { max-height: 34vh; }
  .p-articleMetas.-top { margin-bottom: 4px !important; }
}

@media (max-width: 390px) {
  .c-postTitle__ttl { font-size: 15px !important; line-height: 1.4 !important; }
  .p-articleThumb, .p-entryEyeCatch {
    max-height: 30vh;
    margin-bottom: 6px !important;
  }
  .p-articleThumb__img, .p-entryEyeCatch__img { max-height: 30vh; }
  .p-breadcrumb {
    padding: 2px 0 4px !important;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow-x: auto;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  }
  .p-breadcrumb::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  /* title の左オレンジ bar 細く */
  .p-articleHead.c-postTitle,
  .c-postTitle { border-left-width: 3px !important; padding-left: 9px !important; }
}

/* ── モバイル 固定ページ (page) 特有の調整 ── */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  body.page .p-articleHead.c-postTitle,
  body.page .c-postTitle {
    /* 固定ページは eyecatch ないことが多いので title 下余白やや大きめ */
    margin-bottom: 12px !important;
  }
}

/* ── sticky header が scroll で縮む演出 (class はテーマ or JS 任せ、無くても害なし) ── */
.l-header.-scrolled,
.l-header.is-sticky-scrolled {
  box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.28);
}
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .l-header.-scrolled .l-header__logo,
  .l-header.is-sticky-scrolled .l-header__logo { padding: 2px 2vw !important; }
  .l-header.-scrolled .l-header__inner,
  .l-header.is-sticky-scrolled .l-header__inner { min-height: 40px !important; }
}

/* ── 記事リスト item shadow + hover elevation ── */
.-type-list .p-postList__item,
.p-postList.-list .p-postList__item {
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.04);
  margin-bottom: 6px !important;
  border-radius: 3px;
}
.-type-list .p-postList__item:hover,
.p-postList.-list .p-postList__item:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.22);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.-type-list .p-postList__item a,
.p-postList.-list .p-postList__item a {
  transition: none;
}

/* ── sidebar sticky (desktop: main より short なら top 追従) ── */
@media (min-width: 1024px) {
  .l-sidebar {
    position: sticky;
    top: 72px;
    align-self: start;
    max-height: calc(100vh - 90px);
    overflow-y: auto;
    scrollbar-width: thin;
    padding-bottom: 40px;
  }
  .l-sidebar::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; }
}

/* ── header を scroll 中 backdrop-filter で固める (黒+半透明) ── */
.l-header,
.l-header__inner {
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
}

/* ── 本文 font-feature-settings (日本語改行と英数字の詰め) ── */
body,
.post_content,
.entry-content {
  font-feature-settings: "palt" 1, "kern" 1;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}

/* ── 記事カード (grid type) に subtle corner tape (新着 / NEW 用の飾り) ── */
/* 実際の NEW badge は front-density JS が chip で追加するが、ここでは cover tint を提供 */
.-type-card .p-postList__item[class*="is-yoshi-subtype-live_update"]::before,
.p-postList.-card .p-postList__item[class*="is-yoshi-subtype-live_update"]::before {
  content: 'LIVE';
  position: absolute;
  top: 8px;
  right: 8px;
  z-index: 3;
  background: var(--orange);
  color: var(--white);
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.5px;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.45);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* ── SWELL の「▼ もっと読む」折りたたみ area 見出し強化 ── */
.p-article__readMore,
.c-readMore__btn {
  background: var(--white) !important;
  border: 2px solid var(--orange) !important;
  color: var(--orange) !important;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  letter-spacing: 1px !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  padding: 10px 26px !important;
  transition: background 0.18s, color 0.18s !important;
}
.p-article__readMore:hover,
.c-readMore__btn:hover {
  background: var(--orange) !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
}

/* ── SWELL 関連記事 (.p-relatedPosts) ── */
.p-relatedPosts {
  margin: 26px 0 20px !important;
}
.p-relatedPosts__title,
.p-relatedPosts h2,
.p-relatedPosts h3 {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 16px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  letter-spacing: 1.6px !important;
  color: var(--black) !important;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 4px 0 6px 12px !important;
  margin: 0 0 12px !important;
  border-left: 5px solid var(--orange) !important;
  background: transparent !important;
}
.p-relatedPosts__list,
.p-relatedPosts ul {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)) !important;
  gap: 12px !important;
  list-style: none !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}
.p-relatedPosts__item,
.p-relatedPosts li {
  background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid var(--light-gray);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--orange);
  border-radius: 3px;
  padding: 10px 12px !important;
  transition: transform 0.18s, box-shadow 0.18s, border-left-color 0.18s;
}
.p-relatedPosts__item:hover,
.p-relatedPosts li:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.12);
}
.p-relatedPosts a {
  color: var(--black) !important;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  text-decoration: none !important;
}
.p-relatedPosts a:hover {
  color: var(--orange) !important;
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .p-relatedPosts__list,
  .p-relatedPosts ul { grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; }
}

/* ── smooth scroll (anchor ジャンプが TOC → 見出し等で滑らか) ── */
html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
  scroll-padding-top: 80px;  /* sticky header 分オフセット */
}

/* ── モバイルメニュー open 時の overlay (SWELL default では薄い) ── */
body.menu-open::after,
body.is-spMenuOpen::after {
  content: '';
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.55);
  z-index: 90;
  backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
  pointer-events: none;
  animation: yoshiloFadeIn 0.22s ease forwards;
}
@keyframes yoshiloFadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; }
  to   { opacity: 1; }
}

/* ── 画像 lazy load shimmer (loading="lazy" で placeholder アニメ) ── */
img[loading="lazy"] {
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.04) 0%,
    rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.08) 50%,
    rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.04) 100%
  );
  background-size: 200% 100%;
  animation: yoshiloShimmer 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
img[loading="lazy"].lazyloaded,
img[loading="lazy"][decoded],
img[loading="lazy"][data-loaded="true"] {
  background: none;
  animation: none;
}
@keyframes yoshiloShimmer {
  0%   { background-position: 200% 0; }
  100% { background-position: -200% 0; }
}

/* ── 記事タイトル上のメタ (日付 / カテゴリ) 位置調整 ── */
.p-articleMetas.-top {
  margin-bottom: 10px !important;
  padding: 0 4px !important;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px 16px;
  align-items: center;
}
.p-articleMetas__termList {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
  margin: 0 !important;
}

/* ── SWELL の「▼ もっと読む」記事内アコーディオンラベル ── */
.swell-block-accordion__label,
.swell-block-accordion summary {
  position: relative;
  padding-right: 30px !important;
}
.swell-block-accordion__label::after,
.swell-block-accordion summary::after {
  content: '▾';
  position: absolute;
  right: 12px;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  color: var(--orange);
  font-size: 14px;
  transition: transform 0.2s;
}
.swell-block-accordion.is-open .swell-block-accordion__label::after,
.swell-block-accordion[open] summary::after {
  transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(180deg);
}

/* ── 記事詳細の「次に読みたい記事」見出し (article-bundles の外 lead) ── */
.yoshi-article-bundles__lead {
  font-size: 12.5px !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.3px;
  color: var(--mid-gray);
}
.yoshi-article-bundles__lead::before {
  content: '▶ ';
  color: var(--orange);
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* ── 記事タイトル上のカテゴリチップをより目立たせる ── */
.p-articleMetas__termList .c-categoryList__link {
  transition: background 0.18s, transform 0.18s, box-shadow 0.18s !important;
}
.p-articleMetas__termList .c-categoryList__link:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.15);
}

/* ── 記事内の wp-block-columns (2/3/4 カラム) に gap 調整 ── */
.wp-block-columns {
  gap: 16px !important;
}
.wp-block-column {
  padding: 2px;
}

/* ── 数字強調 (巨人試合スコア 等) の Oswald auto-apply ── */
.post_content .u-num,
.entry-content .u-num,
.post_content [class*="score"],
.entry-content [class*="score"],
.yoshilover-lineup-stats td[align="center"],
.yoshilover-lineup-stats th[align="center"] {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

/* ── 検索バー / 検索フォーム ── */
.c-searchBox__input,
.p-headerSearch__input,
.c-searchForm__s {
  border: 2px solid var(--light-gray) !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  padding: 8px 16px !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
  background: var(--white) !important;
  transition: border-color 0.18s, box-shadow 0.18s !important;
}
.c-searchBox__input:focus,
.p-headerSearch__input:focus,
.c-searchForm__s:focus {
  border-color: var(--orange) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.2) !important;
  outline: none !important;
}
.c-searchBox__btn,
.p-headerSearch__btn,
.c-searchForm__submit {
  background: var(--orange) !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.6px !important;
  transition: opacity 0.18s !important;
}
.c-searchBox__btn:hover,
.p-headerSearch__btn:hover,
.c-searchForm__submit:hover { opacity: 0.88 !important; }
.c-searchForm {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}

/* ── スマホ開閉メニュー ── */
.p-spNav,
.l-spMenu { background: var(--black) !important; }
.p-spNav a,
.l-spMenu a { color: var(--white) !important; }
.p-spNav a:hover,
.l-spMenu a:hover { color: var(--orange) !important; }
.p-spNav__item,
.l-spMenu__item { border-bottom: 1px solid #333 !important; }

/* ── スクロールトップボタン (巨人 orange 円 + hover 黒) ── */
.p-scrollTopBtn,
.c-scrollTopBtn {
  background: var(--orange) !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  width: 44px !important;
  height: 44px !important;
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 18px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.36) !important;
  transition: background 0.18s, transform 0.18s, box-shadow 0.18s !important;
  border: none !important;
}
.p-scrollTopBtn:hover,
.c-scrollTopBtn:hover {
  background: var(--black) !important;
  color: var(--orange) !important;
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.35) !important;
}
/* スクロールトップ icon (i tag inside) 中央配置 */
.p-scrollTopBtn i,
.c-scrollTopBtn i,
.p-scrollTopBtn svg,
.c-scrollTopBtn svg {
  line-height: 1;
}

/* ── ホーム の widget_recent_entries 最初の li を hero 化 (first-child 強調) ── */
.w-frontTop .widget_recent_entries > ul > li:first-child {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--white) 0%, rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.06) 100%) !important;
  border-left-width: 5px !important;
  border-left-color: var(--orange) !important;
  position: relative;
}
.w-frontTop .widget_recent_entries > ul > li:first-child::before {
  content: 'NEW';
  position: absolute;
  top: 8px;
  right: 10px;
  background: var(--orange);
  color: var(--white);
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.4px;
  padding: 2px 7px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.4);
}
.w-frontTop .widget_recent_entries > ul > li:first-child > a {
  font-size: 14.5px !important;
  padding: 13px 14px 13px 16px !important;
}

/* ── SWELL 記事一覧 first item 強調 (category / home post list) ── */
.-type-list .p-postList__item:first-child,
.p-postList.-list .p-postList__item:first-child {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--white) 0%, rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.04) 100%) !important;
}
.-type-list .p-postList__item:first-child .p-postList__ttl,
.p-postList.-list .p-postList__item:first-child .p-postList__ttl {
  font-size: 16px !important;
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .-type-list .p-postList__item:first-child .p-postList__ttl,
  .p-postList.-list .p-postList__item:first-child .p-postList__ttl {
    font-size: 14px !important;
  }
}

/* ── 固定ページ (body.page) の wp-block-heading 巨人 accent ── */
body.page .post_content .wp-block-heading,
body.page .entry-content .wp-block-heading {
  padding-left: 10px;
  border-left: 4px solid var(--orange);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* ── 著者 avatar in author box 拡大 ── */
.c-author__avatar img,
.p-authorBox__avatar img {
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  border: 2px solid var(--orange) !important;
  padding: 1px;
  background: var(--white);
  width: 54px;
  height: 54px;
}

/* ── wp-block-quote の引用元 cite ── */
.wp-block-quote cite,
.post_content blockquote cite,
.entry-content blockquote cite {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 8px;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: 0.6px;
  color: var(--orange);
  font-style: normal;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.wp-block-quote cite::before,
.post_content blockquote cite::before,
.entry-content blockquote cite::before {
  content: '— ';
  color: var(--orange);
}

/* ── 記事本文 番号付きリストの マーカー強化 ── */
.post_content > ol,
.entry-content > ol {
  list-style: none;
  counter-reset: yoshilo-num;
  padding-left: 0;
}
.post_content > ol > li,
.entry-content > ol > li {
  counter-increment: yoshilo-num;
  position: relative;
  padding-left: 36px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  min-height: 28px;
}
.post_content > ol > li::before,
.entry-content > ol > li::before {
  content: counter(yoshilo-num);
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
  background: var(--orange);
  color: var(--white);
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 13px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 999px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.28);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  line-height: 1;
}

/* ── 記事本文 ul を カスタム bullet ── */
.post_content > ul,
.entry-content > ul {
  list-style: none;
  padding-left: 0;
}
.post_content > ul > li,
.entry-content > ul > li {
  position: relative;
  padding-left: 22px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.post_content > ul > li::before,
.entry-content > ul > li::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 4px;
  top: 10px;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  background: var(--orange);
  border-radius: 2px;
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}

/* ── キーワード マーカー (::selection 以外で本文内の黄色蛍光ペン風) ── */
.post_content mark,
.entry-content mark,
.is-style-yoshi-highlight {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 60%, rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.38) 60%);
  padding: 0 2px;
  color: inherit;
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* ── 記事タイトル上の category label に absolute hover ── */
.p-articleMetas__termList .c-categoryList__link {
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
}

/* ── Home Hero ribbon 用の class (将来 DOM 注入用) ── */
.yoshi-home-ribbon {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  background: var(--black);
  border-left: 5px solid var(--orange);
  border-radius: 3px;
  margin: 14px 0;
  color: var(--white);
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
}
.yoshi-home-ribbon__label {
  background: var(--orange);
  color: var(--white);
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 1.4px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.yoshi-home-ribbon__text {
  flex: 1;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

/* ── 記事内 image + caption pair (figure) ── */
.post_content figure:not(.wp-block-table),
.entry-content figure:not(.wp-block-table) {
  margin: 18px 0;
}

/* ── WP の自動生成 gallery ── */
.wp-block-gallery {
  gap: 8px !important;
}
.wp-block-gallery .wp-block-image img {
  border-radius: 3px;
  transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
}
.wp-block-gallery .wp-block-image:hover img {
  transform: scale(1.02);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.18);
}

/* ── 記事メタ 日付 icon 付き ── */
.c-postTimes__posted.icon-posted::before,
.c-postTimes__modified.icon-modified::before {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  color: var(--orange);
  margin-right: 3px;
}

/* ── 記事下 「詳しくはこちら」リンク arrow ── */
.read-more,
.more-link,
.p-postList__more {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  color: var(--orange) !important;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 12px;
  letter-spacing: 0.6px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 4px 0;
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  transition: border-bottom-color 0.18s;
  text-decoration: none !important;
}
.read-more:hover,
.more-link:hover,
.p-postList__more:hover {
  border-bottom-color: var(--orange);
}
.read-more::after,
.more-link::after,
.p-postList__more::after {
  content: '›';
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1;
  margin-left: 2px;
  transition: margin-left 0.18s;
}
.read-more:hover::after,
.more-link:hover::after,
.p-postList__more:hover::after {
  margin-left: 6px;
}

/* ── 本文先頭 category chip pill + 日付 を横並び ── */
.p-articleMetas__termList .c-categoryList__link {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 3px 12px !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
}

/* ── ホーム topic-hub item の最上位 (最初の 1) にも NEW tape 付与 ── */
.yoshi-topic-hub__items > .yoshi-topic-hub__item:first-child {
  position: relative;
  transform: translateY(0);
}
.yoshi-topic-hub__items > .yoshi-topic-hub__item:first-child::before {
  content: 'HOT';
  position: absolute;
  top: -6px;
  right: 10px;
  background: var(--orange);
  color: var(--white);
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.4px;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.5);
  z-index: 2;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

/* ── in-view 反応 (IntersectionObserver + .is-inview class を JS で付ける前提、fallback 自動 fade) ── */
.yoshi-topic-hub__item,
.yoshi-article-bundles__item,
.yoshi-breaking-strip__item,
.yoshilover-related-posts li,
.p-relatedPosts__item,
.p-relatedPosts li {
  animation: yoshiloFadeInUpSoft 0.5s ease backwards;
}
@keyframes yoshiloFadeInUpSoft {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(6px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}
.yoshi-topic-hub__item:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.05s; }
.yoshi-topic-hub__item:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.10s; }
.yoshi-topic-hub__item:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.15s; }
.yoshi-topic-hub__item:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.20s; }

.yoshi-article-bundles__item:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.05s; }
.yoshi-article-bundles__item:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.10s; }
.yoshi-article-bundles__item:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.15s; }

/* ── sidebar widget にも subtle fade ── */
.l-sidebar .widget {
  animation: yoshiloFadeInUpSoft 0.5s ease backwards;
}
.l-sidebar .widget:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.06s; }
.l-sidebar .widget:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.12s; }
.l-sidebar .widget:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.18s; }
.l-sidebar .widget:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.24s; }
.l-sidebar .widget:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 0.30s; }

/* ── 記事タイトルの subtle fade ── */
.c-postTitle__ttl,
.c-pageTitle {
  animation: yoshiloFadeInUpSoft 0.42s ease backwards;
}

/* ── モバイルヘッダ バウンス回避 (overscroll behavior) ── */
html, body {
  overscroll-behavior-x: none;
}

/* ── 記事本文 の 注意書き赤文字 (inline style color: red など) の統一 ── */
.post_content [style*="color:#e53935"],
.post_content [style*="color:#E53935"],
.entry-content [style*="color:red"],
.post_content [style*="color:red"] {
  color: var(--red) !important;
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* ── prev/next 記事ナビ title が長いときの 2 行省略 ── */
.p-pagerPosts__title,
.p-postNav__title,
.p-pagerPosts .__title,
.p-postNav .__title {
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  word-break: break-word;
}

/* ── コメントに画像 (Gravatar fallback) の default colour ── */
.commentlist .avatar[src*="gravatar.com/avatar/00000000000000000000000000000000"],
.comment-list .avatar[alt=""] {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--orange), #E06010);
}

/* ── 固定 post-detail の p-articleHeader 印象強化 (eyecatch 下に影 skew) ── */
.p-articleThumb::after,
.p-entryEyeCatch::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  bottom: -6px;
  width: 48px;
  height: 3px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--orange), transparent);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.p-articleThumb,
.p-entryEyeCatch {
  position: relative;
}

/* ── ブロッククォート ── */
.wp-block-quote,
.post_content blockquote,
.entry-content blockquote {
  border-left: 4px solid var(--orange) !important;
  background: var(--orange-light) !important;
  padding: 14px 18px !important;
  border-radius: 2px;
  position: relative;
  color: var(--black);
  font-style: normal;
}
.wp-block-quote::before,
.post_content blockquote::before,
.entry-content blockquote::before {
  content: '\201C';
  position: absolute;
  top: -4px;
  left: 8px;
  font-family: 'Oswald', Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 36px;
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--orange);
  opacity: 0.55;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.wp-block-quote > :first-child,
.post_content blockquote > :first-child,
.entry-content blockquote > :first-child {
  margin-top: 0;
  padding-left: 22px;
}

/* ── 記事本文 table ── */
.post_content table,
.entry-content table,
.wp-block-table table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  border: 1px solid var(--light-gray);
  margin: 14px 0;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  background: var(--white);
}
.post_content table th,
.entry-content table th,
.wp-block-table table th {
  background: var(--black);
  color: var(--white);
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.8px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-right: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  text-align: left;
}
.post_content table th:last-child,
.entry-content table th:last-child { border-right: none; }
.post_content table td,
.entry-content table td,
.wp-block-table table td {
  padding: 9px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--light-gray);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--light-gray);
  color: var(--dark-gray);
}
.post_content table td:last-child,
.entry-content table td:last-child { border-right: none; }
.post_content table tbody tr:nth-child(even),
.entry-content table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
  background: rgba(245, 245, 240, 0.6);
}
.post_content table tbody tr:hover,
.entry-content table tbody tr:hover {
  background: var(--orange-light);
}

/* ── 記事本文 hr / separator ── */
.post_content hr,
.entry-content hr,
.wp-block-separator {
  border: 0 !important;
  height: 2px !important;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--orange) 0, var(--orange) 36px, var(--light-gray) 36px) !important;
  margin: 24px 0 !important;
  opacity: 1 !important;
}

/* ── 記事本文 ul / ol ── */
.post_content > ul,
.entry-content > ul,
.post_content > ol,
.entry-content > ol {
  padding-left: 1.4em;
  line-height: 1.8;
}
.post_content > ul > li::marker,
.entry-content > ul > li::marker {
  color: var(--orange);
}
.post_content > ol > li::marker,
.entry-content > ol > li::marker {
  color: var(--orange);
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* ── CTA ボタン: 全て orange 背景 + 白文字 (巨人統一) ── */
.wp-block-button .wp-block-button__link,
.wp-block-button.is-style-outline .wp-block-button__link,
.wp-block-button.is-style-fill .wp-block-button__link,
.c-btn,
.swell-block-button a,
.swell-block-button.is-style-outline a,
.swell-block-button.is-style-fill a,
.p-loadMoreBtn,
.c-loadMore__btn,
.p-article__readMore,
.c-readMore__btn,
.yoshi-x-follow-cta__btn,
.comment-form .submit,
#submit,
.c-searchBox__btn,
.p-headerSearch__btn,
.c-searchForm__submit,
a[href="#respond"].wp-block-button__link,
a[href*="#respond"].wp-block-button__link,
button.cta,
.yoshi-cta-btn {
  background: var(--orange) !important;
  background-color: var(--orange) !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
  border: 2px solid var(--orange) !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.8px !important;
  padding: 12px 26px !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: transform 0.18s, box-shadow 0.18s, opacity 0.18s, background 0.18s !important;
  display: inline-block;
  text-align: center;
}
.wp-block-button .wp-block-button__link:hover,
.wp-block-button.is-style-outline .wp-block-button__link:hover,
.c-btn:hover,
.swell-block-button a:hover,
.p-loadMoreBtn:hover,
.c-readMore__btn:hover,
.p-article__readMore:hover,
.yoshi-x-follow-cta__btn:hover,
.comment-form .submit:hover,
#submit:hover,
.c-searchForm__submit:hover,
button.cta:hover,
.yoshi-cta-btn:hover {
  background: var(--orange) !important;
  background-color: var(--orange) !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
  opacity: 0.92 !important;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 14px rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.38) !important;
}
/* CTA 内部 span / i / img の色も白に継承 */
.wp-block-button .wp-block-button__link *,
.swell-block-button a *,
.c-btn *,
.yoshi-cta-btn * {
  color: var(--white) !important;
}

/* ── SWELL キャプションボックス (swell-block-capbox) ── */
.swell-block-capbox,
.p-capBox,
.is-style-capbox,
.is-style-capbox1,
.is-style-capbox2 {
  background: var(--white) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--light-gray) !important;
  border-top: 4px solid var(--orange) !important;
  border-radius: 4px !important;
  padding: 14px 16px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.04);
  margin: 18px 0;
}
.swell-block-capbox__label,
.p-capBox__label {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 12px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  letter-spacing: 1.2px !important;
  color: var(--black) !important;
  padding: 2px 10px !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  background: rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.12) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.35) !important;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* ── SWELL FAQ / アコーディオン ── */
.swell-block-faq,
.swell-block-accordion {
  border-radius: 4px !important;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--light-gray) !important;
  margin: 14px 0;
}
.swell-block-faq__item,
.swell-block-accordion__item {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--light-gray) !important;
}
.swell-block-faq__item:last-child,
.swell-block-accordion__item:last-child { border-bottom: none !important; }
.swell-block-faq__q,
.swell-block-accordion__title {
  background: var(--white) !important;
  padding: 12px 14px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: var(--black) !important;
  border-left: 4px solid var(--orange) !important;
  transition: background 0.15s !important;
}
.swell-block-faq__q:hover,
.swell-block-accordion__title:hover { background: var(--orange-light) !important; }

/* ── SWELL ステップ ── */
.swell-block-step__number,
.p-stepList__number {
  background: var(--orange) !important;
  color: var(--white) !important;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.6px !important;
}
.swell-block-step__title,
.p-stepList__title {
  color: var(--black) !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
}
.swell-block-step__body,
.p-stepList__body {
  border-left: 2px solid rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.3);
  padding-left: 14px;
}

/* ── SWELL 枠 (is-style-*) 汎用 ── */
.is-style-sticky-orange { border-left: 4px solid var(--orange) !important; background: var(--orange-light) !important; padding: 12px 16px !important; border-radius: 2px; }
.is-style-sticky-black  { border-left: 4px solid var(--black)  !important; background: rgba(26,26,26,0.04) !important; padding: 12px 16px !important; border-radius: 2px; }

/* ── レスポンシブ ── */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .-type-list .p-postList__eyecatch,
  .p-postList.-list .p-postList__eyecatch {
    width: 90px !important;
    height: 60px !important;
  }
  .-type-list .p-postList__ttl,
  .p-postList.-list .p-postList__ttl { font-size: 14px !important; }
  .-type-list .p-postList__item a,
  .p-postList.-list .p-postList__item a { padding: 12px 14px; }
  .wp-block-embed-twitter { max-width: 100%; }

  /* カテゴリナビはスマホでも横スクロール */
  .c-gnav, .l-gnav, .p-gnav {
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   063 — topic hub / 記事下 SNS 反応 block
   ・トップ front_top widget に常設 (「今週の話題」)
   ・SNS block は公式 X / 中の人 X が per-post meta にある時だけ
   ・2026-04-24: 巨人オレンジ hero strip に格上げ(orange/black/white のみ)
   ============================================================ */

.yoshi-topic-hub {
  background: var(--black);
  border-top: 5px solid var(--orange);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 14px 14px 16px;
  margin: 20px 0;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.12);
}
.yoshi-topic-hub__heading {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  color: var(--white);
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  padding: 0 2px;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.yoshi-topic-hub__heading::before {
  content: '';
  display: inline-block;
  width: 5px;
  height: 22px;
  background: var(--orange);
  border-radius: 1px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.yoshi-topic-hub__heading::after {
  content: 'THIS WEEK';
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 2.5px;
  color: var(--orange);
  margin-left: auto;
  padding-right: 2px;
  align-self: center;
  line-height: 1;
}
.yoshi-topic-hub__items {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
}
.yoshi-topic-hub__item {
  background: var(--white);
  border-left: 4px solid var(--orange);
  border-radius: 3px;
  transition: background 0.18s, transform 0.18s, box-shadow 0.18s;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
}
.yoshi-topic-hub__item:hover {
  background: var(--orange-light);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.22);
}
.yoshi-topic-hub__link {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 12px 14px 13px;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
}
.yoshi-topic-hub__badge {
  display: inline-block;
  background: var(--orange);
  color: var(--white);
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;

/* 388 (2026-05-20): chip 数を CSS で gating する。 plugin php 側は live に 100 chip
   出力する v16 が乗っており、 XSERVER WAF が plugin php push を block するため、
   CSS で表示を絞ることで PC 30 / mobile 7 target を実現する。
   PC (601px 以上) = 固定 8 + player 30 = 38 chip 可視 (横スクロール)。 39 番目以降は hide。
   mobile (600px 以下) = 固定 8 + player 7 = 15 chip 可視 (折り返し 3 段)。 16 番目以降は hide。
   user 判断 2026-05-20: PC 30 / mobile 10-15 目安、 chip 数を絞って疎にする。
   user 判断 2026-05-20 (追記): スマホは横スクロールではなく折り返し、 3 段に収まる量。
   note: WP の wp_strip_all_tags が CSS option を sanitize する際に
   左不等号 (lt-sign) から次の `]` 以外の右不等号 (gt-sign) まで HTML tag 扱いで
   strip する。 コメント内に lt-sign を書かないこと (CSS rule が消える)。 */
@media (min-width: 601px) {
  .yoshi-dense-nav__item:nth-child(n+39) {
    display: none;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .yoshi-dense-nav {
    margin-top: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
  .yoshi-dense-nav__scroll {
    overflow-x: visible;
    margin-left: -2px;
    margin-right: -2px;
    padding-bottom: 2px;
  }
  .yoshi-dense-nav__list {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
  }
  .yoshi-dense-nav__link {
    min-height: 36px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    font-size: 12px;
  }
  .yoshi-dense-nav__item:nth-child(n+16) {
    display: none;
  }
}

.yoshi-ad {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  margin: 24px 0;
}

.yoshi-ad__placeholder {
  width: 100%;
}

.yoshi-ad__placeholder:empty {
  display: none;
}

.yoshi-ad__placeholder:not(:empty) {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 18px;
}

.yoshi-ad__fallback,
.yoshi-ad-fallback {
  display: none;
}

.yoshi-ad__placeholder:empty + .yoshi-ad__fallback,
.yoshi-ad__placeholder:empty + .yoshi-ad-fallback {
  display: block;
}

.yoshi-ad__placeholder:not(:empty) + .yoshi-ad__fallback,
.yoshi-ad__placeholder:not(:empty) + .yoshi-ad-fallback {
  display: none;
}

.yoshi-ad__fallback-link {

  gap: 8px;
  padding: 14px 16px;

  align-items: center;
  padding: 0 8px;

/* ============================================================
   nomotoke-source-excerpt（記事末の元記事本文 600 字抜粋ブロック）
   Giants カラー(オレンジ + ブルー)で「報知/日刊/sponichi 引用」を強調
   ============================================================ */

aside.nomotoke-source-excerpt {
  position: relative;
  margin: 28px 0 32px;
  padding: 18px 22px 16px 26px;
  background: var(--orange-light);
  border-left: 4px solid var(--orange);
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 61, 165, 0.12);
  border-right: 1px solid rgba(0, 61, 165, 0.12);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0, 61, 165, 0.12);
  border-radius: 4px 8px 8px 4px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.04);
}

/* ラベル（📖 本文抜粋） */
.nomotoke-source-excerpt__label {
  display: inline-block;
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  padding: 3px 10px;
  color: var(--white);
  background: var(--blue);
  font-family: 'Oswald', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  line-height: 1.4;
  border-radius: 3px;
}

/* 本文 blockquote */
.nomotoke-source-excerpt__body {
  margin: 6px 0 10px;
  padding: 0;
  border: none;
  color: var(--black);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.85;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  background: transparent;
}

.nomotoke-source-excerpt__body p {
  margin: 0 0 1.1em;
  line-height: 2.0;
  /* 2026-05-14 user 指示: 引用本文を太字化 (デザインはそのまま、文字だけ太く) */
  font-weight: 700;
}

.nomotoke-source-excerpt__body p:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* A. ◆/●/■/▶/▼ で始まる小見出し行 — 試合概要 / 章タイトル */
.nomotoke-source-excerpt__body .nomotoke-source-excerpt__heading {
  margin: 0 0 0.9em;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--blue);
  background: rgba(0, 61, 165, 0.06);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--blue);
  border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
}

/* B. 「...」 直接話法を独立 blockquote 化 — 監督・選手・OB コメント */
.nomotoke-source-excerpt__body .nomotoke-source-excerpt__inner-quote {
  margin: 0.4em 0 1.1em;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  border: none;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--orange);
  background: rgba(245, 127, 23, 0.05);
  border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
  color: var(--black);
  font-style: normal;
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.95;
  /* 2026-05-14 user 指示: 引用本文を太字化 (発言部分も同様) */
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* スマホ最適化 (新規 class) */
@media (max-width: 599px) {
  .nomotoke-source-excerpt__body .nomotoke-source-excerpt__heading {
    font-size: 13px;
    padding: 3px 8px;
  }
  .nomotoke-source-excerpt__body .nomotoke-source-excerpt__inner-quote {
    font-size: 14px;
    padding: 6px 11px;
    line-height: 1.85;
  }
}

/* 出典（— 報知新聞 など） */
.nomotoke-source-excerpt__attr {
  margin: 8px 0 0;
  text-align: right;
  color: var(--mid-gray);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-style: italic;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.nomotoke-source-excerpt__attr::before {
  content: "";
  display: inline-block;
  width: 18px;
  height: 1px;
  margin-right: 6px;
  vertical-align: middle;
  background: var(--orange);
}

/* スマホ最適化 */
@media (max-width: 599px) {
  aside.nomotoke-source-excerpt {
    margin: 22px 0 26px;
    padding: 14px 16px 12px 18px;
    border-left-width: 3px;
  }
  .nomotoke-source-excerpt__label {
    font-size: 11px;
    padding: 2px 8px;
  }
  .nomotoke-source-excerpt__body {
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.8;
  }
  .nomotoke-source-excerpt__attr {
    font-size: 11px;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   v0.23 REFINEMENT LAYER (2026-06-12)
   目的: サイト全体の「洗練」— 書体 / 余白リズム / 角丸・影・色数の統一
   方針: 既存ルールの後段 override のみ。構造(PHP/HTML)変更なし、可逆。
   token: --yl-r(カード角丸) / --yl-r-sm(内側要素) / --yl-bd(罫線) / --yl-sh(影)
   ============================================================ */

:root {
  --yl-r: 12px;
  --yl-r-sm: 8px;
  --yl-bd: #E9E6DE;
  --yl-sh: 0 1px 2px rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.04), 0 6px 18px rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.05);
  --yl-sh-hover: 0 2px 4px rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.05), 0 10px 26px rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.13);
}

/* ── 1. タイポグラフィ: Noto Sans JP へ昇格 + レンダリング改善 ── */
body {
  font-family: 'Noto Sans JP', '游ゴシック体', 'Yu Gothic', YuGothic,
    'Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN', 'Hiragino Sans', Meiryo, sans-serif !important;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}
h1, h2, h3, h4,
.yoshi-home-data__t,
.yoshi-breaking-strip__title,
.yoshi-topic-hub__title,
.yoshi-today-giants__title,
.yoshi-sidebar-rail__popular-title {
  font-feature-settings: 'palt';
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}
.post_content {
  letter-spacing: 0.015em;
  line-height: 1.85;
}

/* ── 2. ホーム: セクション間の呼吸(余白リズム統一) ── */
.w-frontTop .c-widget,
.w-frontTop > section,
.yoshi-home-data,
.yoshi-breaking-strip,
.yoshi-topic-hub,
.yoshi-brand-about {
  margin-top: 0;
  margin-bottom: 28px !important;
}

/* ── 3. カード様式統一: 角丸・罫線・影を 1 トーンに ── */
.yoshi-home-data,
.yoshi-breaking-strip,
.yoshi-topic-hub,
.yoshi-brand-about,
.yoshi-today-giants,
.yoshi-sidebar-rail__section {
  border-radius: var(--yl-r) !important;
  border-color: var(--yl-bd) !important;
  box-shadow: var(--yl-sh) !important;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* ── 4. データハブ: 絵文字アイコンを「意図したデザイン」に見せる ── */
.yoshi-home-data__card {
  border-radius: var(--yl-r-sm) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--yl-bd) !important;
  transition: transform 0.18s ease, box-shadow 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease;
}
.yoshi-home-data__card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: var(--yl-sh-hover) !important;
  border-color: rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.45) !important;
}
.yoshi-home-data__ic {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  background: var(--orange-light);
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1;
}

/* ── 5. 最近の投稿: 詰まった白帯の壁 → 呼吸のあるリスト ── */
.w-frontTop .widget_recent_entries > ul {
  gap: 8px;
}
.w-frontTop .widget_recent_entries > ul > li {
  border-radius: var(--yl-r-sm);
  border-color: var(--yl-bd);
  border-left-width: 3px;
  transition: border-color 0.18s, background 0.18s, transform 0.18s, box-shadow 0.18s;
}
.w-frontTop .widget_recent_entries > ul > li:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: var(--yl-sh-hover);
}
.w-frontTop .widget_recent_entries > ul > li > a {
  padding: 13px 16px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: #222222 !important;
}

/* ── 6. 速報帯 / 今週の話題 / 今日の巨人: 内側アイテムの角丸統一 ── */
.yoshi-breaking-strip__link,
.yoshi-topic-hub__link,
.yoshi-today-giants__link,
.yoshi-sidebar-rail__popular-link,
.yoshi-sidebar-rail__topic-link {
  border-radius: var(--yl-r-sm) !important;
  transition: background 0.18s, border-color 0.18s;
}

/* ── 7. チップ・バッジの色数規律: 彩度の強いベタ塗りを淡色化 ── */
.yoshi-breaking-strip__chip,
.yoshi-today-giants__chip,
.yoshi-sidebar-rail__category-chip {
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

/* ── 8. dense-nav: 高密度チップ → 静かなピル型 ── */
.yoshi-dense-nav__link {
  background: var(--white) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--yl-bd) !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  transition: background 0.18s, border-color 0.18s, color 0.18s;
}
.yoshi-dense-nav__link:hover {
  background: var(--orange-light) !important;
  border-color: rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.45) !important;
}

/* ── 9. サイドバー: 行間と密度を読みやすさ側へ ── */
.yoshi-sidebar-rail__popular-title,
.yoshi-sidebar-rail__topic-title,
.yoshi-today-giants__title {
  line-height: 1.55 !important;
}
.yoshi-sidebar-rail__popular-item + .yoshi-sidebar-rail__popular-item,
.yoshi-today-giants__item + .yoshi-today-giants__item {
  margin-top: 6px;
}

/* ── 10. 記事本文: 画像・埋め込み・テーブルの角の統一 ── */
.post_content img,
.post_content .wp-block-embed,
.post_content table {
  border-radius: var(--yl-r-sm);
}
.post_content table {
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* ── 11. アクセシビリティ兼質感: キーボードフォーカスリング統一 ── */
a:focus-visible,
button:focus-visible,
input:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.8);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  border-radius: 4px;
}

/* ── 12. モバイル: 余白と角丸を画面幅に合わせて微調整 ── */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  :root {
    --yl-r: 10px;
    --yl-r-sm: 7px;
  }
  .w-frontTop .c-widget,
  .yoshi-home-data,
  .yoshi-breaking-strip,
  .yoshi-topic-hub {
    margin-bottom: 20px !important;
  }
  .w-frontTop .widget_recent_entries > ul {
    gap: 6px;
  }
  .w-frontTop .widget_recent_entries > ul > li > a {
    padding: 12px 14px;
    font-size: 13.5px;
  }
}

/* 列ヘッダ行 (投稿者/投稿) は撤去 */
#bbpress-forums ul.bbp-replies li.bbp-header {
  display: none !important;
}

/* メタ帯: 帯感をなくし「レス番号 + 日時 + 返信」の1行に */
#bbpress-forums ul.bbp-replies {
  counter-reset: ylres 0;
}
#bbpress-forums ul.bbp-replies li.bbp-body > div.bbp-reply-header {
  counter-increment: ylres;
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none !important;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--yl-bd) !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 12px 16px 0 !important;
}
#bbpress-forums ul.bbp-replies li.bbp-body > div.bbp-reply-header:first-child {
  border-top: none !important;
}
#bbpress-forums ul.bbp-replies .bbp-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: #9A958C;
}
#bbpress-forums ul.bbp-replies a.bbp-reply-permalink {
  order: 0;
  font-size: 0 !important;
  text-decoration: none;
}
#bbpress-forums ul.bbp-replies a.bbp-reply-permalink::before {
  content: counter(ylres);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #C45F00;
  background: var(--orange-light);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 1px 8px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  display: inline-block;
}
#bbpress-forums ul.bbp-replies span.bbp-reply-post-date {
  order: 1;
  margin-left: auto;
}
#bbpress-forums ul.bbp-replies span.bbp-admin-links {
  order: 2;
}
#bbpress-forums ul.bbp-replies span.bbp-admin-links a {
  color: var(--mid-gray);
  text-decoration: none;
}
#bbpress-forums ul.bbp-replies span.bbp-admin-links a:hover {
  color: var(--orange);
}

/* 投稿ブロック: 著者列の float 解除、奇偶背景の撤去 */

  background: var(--white) !important;
  border: none !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 6px 16px 14px !important;
  display: block;
}
#bbpress-forums ul.bbp-replies div.bbp-reply-author {
  float: none !important;
  width: auto !important;
  min-height: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 0 4px !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  text-align: left !important;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
}
#bbpress-forums ul.bbp-replies div.bbp-reply-author a.bbp-author-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  text-decoration: none;
}
#bbpress-forums ul.bbp-replies div.bbp-reply-author img.avatar {
  width: 30px !important;
  height: 30px !important;
  border-radius: 50% !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--yl-bd);
}
#bbpress-forums ul.bbp-replies div.bbp-reply-author .bbp-author-name {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--black);
}
#bbpress-forums ul.bbp-replies div.bbp-author-role {
  font-size: 10px !important;
  font-style: normal !important;
  background: rgba(245, 129, 31, 0.12);
  color: #C45F00;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 1px 8px;
}
#bbpress-forums ul.bbp-replies div.bbp-reply-content {
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  line-height: 1.75;
}

  margin: 0 0 8px;
}

.yoshi-board-like {
  margin-top: 8px;
}
.yoshi-board-like__btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;

  border: 1px solid var(--yl-bd);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 4px 14px;
  font-size: 12.5px;

}

<script id="yoshilover-063-front-density-js-after">
(() => {
  const config = window.yoshilover063FrontDensity || {};
  const cards = config.cards || {};
  const normalizePath = (href) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(href, window.location.origin);
      const path = (url.pathname || '').replace(/\/+$/, '');
      return path || '/';
    } catch (error) {
      return href || '';
    }
  };
  const createNode = (tag, className, text) => {
    const node = document.createElement(tag);
    node.className = className;
    node.textContent = text;
    return node;
  };
  const injectCard = (item, meta) => {
    if (!item || !meta || item.dataset.yoshiFrontDensity === '1') {
      return;
    }
    const body = item.querySelector('.p-postList__body');
    const title = body ? body.querySelector('.p-postList__title, .p-postList__ttl, h2') : null;
    if (!body || !title) {
      return;
    }

    const metaRow = document.createElement('div');
    metaRow.className = 'yoshi-front-card__meta';

    if (meta.label) {
      metaRow.appendChild(createNode('span', `yoshi-front-card__badge yoshi-front-card__badge--${meta.subtype || 'generic'}`, meta.label));
    }
    if (meta.phase) {
      metaRow.appendChild(createNode('span', 'yoshi-front-card__chip yoshi-front-card__chip--phase', meta.phase));
    }
    if (meta.score) {
      metaRow.appendChild(createNode('span', 'yoshi-front-card__chip yoshi-front-card__chip--score', meta.score));
    }
    if (meta.comment_count && Number(meta.comment_count) > 0) {
      metaRow.appendChild(createNode('span', 'yoshi-front-card__chip yoshi-front-card__chip--comments yoshi-sidebar-rail__popular-comments', `💬 ${meta.comment_count}`));
    }
    if (meta.primary_player) {
      metaRow.appendChild(createNode('span', 'yoshi-front-card__chip yoshi-front-card__chip--player', meta.primary_player));
    }
    if (meta.read_length_label) {
      metaRow.appendChild(createNode('span', `yoshi-front-card__chip yoshi-front-card__chip--read yoshi-front-card__chip--read-${meta.read_length_tone || 'mid'}`, meta.read_length_label));
    }
    if (meta.chain) {
      metaRow.appendChild(createNode('span', 'yoshi-front-card__chip yoshi-front-card__chip--chain', meta.chain));
    }
    const detailRow = document.createElement('div');
    detailRow.className = 'yoshi-front-card__detail';
    if (meta.is_new) {
      detailRow.appendChild(createNode('span', 'yoshi-front-card__detail-chip yoshi-front-card__detail-chip--new', 'NEW'));
    }
    if (meta.relative_time) {
      detailRow.appendChild(createNode('time', 'yoshi-front-card__detail-chip yoshi-front-card__detail-chip--time', meta.relative_time));
    }
    if (meta.opponent) {
      detailRow.appendChild(createNode('span', 'yoshi-front-card__detail-chip yoshi-front-card__detail-chip--opponent', meta.opponent));
    }
    if (meta.primary_category) {
      detailRow.appendChild(createNode('span', 'yoshi-front-card__detail-chip yoshi-front-card__detail-chip--category', meta.primary_category));
    }
    if (meta.primary_tag) {
      detailRow.appendChild(createNode('span', 'yoshi-front-card__detail-chip yoshi-front-card__detail-chip--tag', meta.primary_tag));
    }
    if (meta.summary) {
      const summary = createNode('p', 'yoshi-front-card__summary', meta.summary);
      title.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', summary);
      if (detailRow.childNodes.length > 0) {
        summary.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', detailRow);
      }
    } else if (detailRow.childNodes.length > 0) {
      title.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', detailRow);
    }
    if (metaRow.childNodes.length > 0) {
      title.insertAdjacentElement('beforebegin', metaRow);
    }

    item.dataset.yoshiFrontDensity = '1';
    item.classList.add('is-yoshi-front-density');
    if (meta.subtype) {
      item.classList.add(`is-yoshi-subtype-${meta.subtype}`);
    }
  };

  document.querySelectorAll('.p-postList__item').forEach((item) => {
    const link = item.querySelector('a[href]');
    if (!link) {
      return;
    }
    const meta = cards[normalizePath(link.href)];
    if (meta) {
      injectCard(item, meta);
    }
  });
})();

</script>
